阿爺廚房 (Sr.3) 17 順德人愛用陳皮入饌，鼎爺帶阿譚到當地享用滋陰補腎靚湯陳皮燉青頭鴨，還傳授?柑皮的技巧，並講解青柑皮與紅柑皮的分別鼎爺購入特級陳皮，配合蝦仁火鴨鹹蛋黃等豐富食材，奉上功夫菜陳皮八寶鴨陳皮香味滲透米鴨內外，美味昇華為令蝦仁更爽口，鼎爺還以細膩刀功去掉蝦衣！深入工場一探布包豆腐的製作過程之後，鼎爺又有新煮意！生拆蟹鉗蒸豆腐配搭巧妙，鮮甜味美要將生蟹鉗拆肉，有甚麼技巧？
香港原味道 (Sr.5) 11 蛋卷店負責人為子女創業，創作不同口味的蛋卷製作過程用料一絲不苟，負責人除了精選優質雞蛋，還專程購買新鮮椰汁，堅持新鮮製作頌鵬初試捲蛋卷，成品如何？主持再到位於西貢的魚排，品嚐以生猛金錢斑與金頭鯛炮製的菜式，魚排設24小時水質監測系統，給香港人優質海魚有自動販賣機售賣健康為本的中式飯糰，庭鋒天佑到工場體驗製作工序！今集派出農耕男孩庭鋒正峰天佑上山採野生茅根，他們能鋤得滿意的收成嗎？
香港原味道 (Sr.5) 12 室內養殖魚場引入澳洲國寶魚墨瑞鱈魚，奈何疫情令魚滯銷，但無阻場主向港人推廣的決心，還即席炮製墨瑞鱈魚三食讓主持品嚐！大廚黃亞保在疫境下鑽研即食餸包，令繁忙都市人能輕易品嚐陳皮紅豆沙客家燜腩仔等功夫美食，方便快捷主持化身收割員採收本地水稻，亦不忘品嚐本地米原味道，象尖米元朗大棠絲苗的形狀質感有何不同？今集派出頌鵬德賢走進本地養豬場，完成幫黑毛豬沖涼餵奶等任務，順道認識優質本地黑毛豬
香港原味道 (Sr.5) 13 本地有機檸檬園種植逾七千棵檸檬樹，負責人講求品質而進修種植知識，亦在疫情期間向社群送出檸檬檸檬除了可用來沖水入饌，還可製成果乾一對曾於英國留學的情侶，將本地香水檸檬融入外國飲料，加入果皮草果等調較出與別不同的湯力水與梳打水主持一睹製作過程，又一試香港原味道的湯力水馬貫東在疫情下經營湯料包生意，為甚麼會有這個念頭？且聽他介紹時令湯水之選天佑庭鋒被派往劈竹蔗採桑葉，炮製清甜滋潤飲料

香港原味道 (Sr.5) 13 本地有機檸檬園種植逾七千棵檸檬樹，負責人講求品質而進修種植知識，亦在疫情期間向社群送出檸檬檸檬除了可用來沖水入饌，還可製成果乾一對曾於英國留學的情侶，將本地香水檸檬融入外國飲料，加入果皮草果等調較出與別不同的湯力水與梳打水主持一睹製作過程，又一試香港原味道的湯力水馬貫東在疫情下經營湯料包生意，為甚麼會有這個念頭？且聽他介紹時令湯水之選天佑庭鋒被派往劈竹蔗採桑葉，炮製清甜滋潤飲料
阿爺廚房 (Sr.3) 15 鼎爺與阿譚清早來到逢簡河畔，探究順德河鮮肥美鮮甜的因由二人吃過馳名順德魚粥後意猶未盡，鼎爺選用大魚魚頭，炮製據稱有去頭風療效的川芎白芷天麻燉魚頭湯，箇中美味連阿譚亦食指大動！及後烹調的荷葉蒸雞同樣用料十足，除了用上蟲草花冬菇雲耳紅棗，鼎爺還特別以乾荷葉與新鮮荷葉包着雞項蒸煮，成品究竟有多滋味？挑選刀具要講究，去除魚腥泥味亦有學問，鼎爺於示範期間逐一公開他的私房烹飪心得
阿爺廚房 (Sr.3) 16 順德大良以飼養水牛聞名，以水牛奶做成的牛乳和雙皮奶，奶味尤其香濃鼎爺帶阿譚見識手工牛乳的製作工序後煮意大發，巧製鮮甜滋味的牛乳鯇片粥，自製鍋巴夾牛乳則香脆可口鍋巴怎樣才可炸得鬆化？阿譚手癢試炸，卻成了錯誤示範！海南雞飯雞滑飯香，加上雞雜煮白菜湯，可謂完美配搭！鼎爺堅持選用新鮮黃薑入飯，它比黃薑粉有何優勝之處？此外，不論雪藏雞或冰鮮雞，均可煮出鼎級海南雞飯，關鍵又在哪裡？
阿爺廚房 (Sr.3) 17 順德人愛用陳皮入饌，鼎爺帶阿譚到當地享用滋陰補腎靚湯陳皮燉青頭鴨，還傳授?柑皮的技巧，並講解青柑皮與紅柑皮的分別鼎爺購入特級陳皮，配合蝦仁火鴨鹹蛋黃等豐富食材，奉上功夫菜陳皮八寶鴨陳皮香味滲透米鴨內外，美味昇華為令蝦仁更爽口，鼎爺還以細膩刀功去掉蝦衣！深入工場一探布包豆腐的製作過程之後，鼎爺又有新煮意！生拆蟹鉗蒸豆腐配搭巧妙，鮮甜味美要將生蟹鉗拆肉，有甚麼技巧？

阿爺廚房 (Sr.3) 19 順德大良以飼養水牛聞名，以水牛奶做成的牛乳和雙皮奶，奶味尤其香濃鼎爺帶阿譚見識手工牛乳的製作工序後煮意大發，巧製鮮甜滋味的牛乳鯇片粥，自製鍋巴夾牛乳則香脆可口鍋巴怎樣才可炸得鬆化？阿譚手癢試炸，卻成了錯誤示範！海南雞飯雞滑飯香，加上雞雜煮白菜湯，可謂完美配搭！鼎爺堅持選用新鮮黃薑入飯，它比黃薑粉有何優勝之處？此外，不論雪藏雞或冰鮮雞，均可煮出鼎級海南雞飯，關鍵又在哪裡？
阿爺廚房 (Sr.3) 20 順德人愛用陳皮入饌，鼎爺帶阿譚到當地享用滋陰補腎靚湯陳皮燉青頭鴨，還傳授?柑皮的技巧，並講解青柑皮與紅柑皮的分別鼎爺購入特級陳皮，配合蝦仁火鴨鹹蛋黃等豐富食材，奉上功夫菜陳皮八寶鴨陳皮香味滲透米鴨內外，美味昇華為令蝦仁更爽口，鼎爺還以細膩刀功去掉蝦衣！深入工場一探布包豆腐的製作過程之後，鼎爺又有新煮意！生拆蟹鉗蒸豆腐配搭巧妙，鮮甜味美要將生蟹鉗拆肉，有甚麼技巧？
香港原味道 (Sr.5) 14 蛋卷店負責人為子女創業，創作不同口味的蛋卷製作過程用料一絲不苟，負責人除了精選優質雞蛋，還專程購買新鮮椰汁，堅持新鮮製作頌鵬初試捲蛋卷，成品如何？主持再到位於西貢的魚排，品嚐以生猛金錢斑與金頭鯛炮製的菜式，魚排設24小時水質監測系統，給香港人優質海魚有自動販賣機售賣健康為本的中式飯糰，庭鋒天佑到工場體驗製作工序！今集派出農耕男孩庭鋒正峰天佑上山採野生茅根，他們能鋤得滿意的收成嗎？
香港原味道 (Sr.5) 15 室內養殖魚場引入澳洲國寶魚墨瑞鱈魚，奈何疫情令魚滯銷，但無阻場主向港人推廣的決心，還即席炮製墨瑞鱈魚三食讓主持品嚐！大廚黃亞保在疫境下鑽研即食餸包，令繁忙都市人能輕易品嚐陳皮紅豆沙客家燜腩仔等功夫美食，方便快捷主持化身收割員採收本地水稻，亦不忘品嚐本地米原味道，象尖米元朗大棠絲苗的形狀質感有何不同？今集派出頌鵬德賢走進本地養豬場，完成幫黑毛豬沖涼餵奶等任務，順道認識優質本地黑毛豬
輝哥為食遊 1 節目第一集，輝哥吳錫輝和糖妹黃山怡前赴中山潮汕等地為食遊中山脆肉鯇魚肉質爽脆，有何飼養秘訣？名廚烹調脆鯇一魚六吃，以晶瑩剔透的魚片涮火鍋鮮味無比！汕頭魚丸香脆彈牙，採用甚麼魚製作？且看師傅施展拍打功絕技，炮製雪白圓滿手打魚丸糖妹亦有樣學樣，鬼馬巧製老人丸孝敬輝哥！潮汕打冷堪稱潮式快餐，林林總總的海鮮生熟美食鹵水小吃多達四百餘種；輝哥還順道細說兒時吃潮州粥的艱難日子

香港原味道 (Sr.5) 15 室內養殖魚場引入澳洲國寶魚墨瑞鱈魚，奈何疫情令魚滯銷，但無阻場主向港人推廣的決心，還即席炮製墨瑞鱈魚三食讓主持品嚐！大廚黃亞保在疫境下鑽研即食餸包，令繁忙都市人能輕易品嚐陳皮紅豆沙客家燜腩仔等功夫美食，方便快捷主持化身收割員採收本地水稻，亦不忘品嚐本地米原味道，象尖米元朗大棠絲苗的形狀質感有何不同？今集派出頌鵬德賢走進本地養豬場，完成幫黑毛豬沖涼餵奶等任務，順道認識優質本地黑毛豬
輝哥為食遊 1 節目第一集，輝哥吳錫輝和糖妹黃山怡前赴中山潮汕等地為食遊中山脆肉鯇魚肉質爽脆，有何飼養秘訣？名廚烹調脆鯇一魚六吃，以晶瑩剔透的魚片涮火鍋鮮味無比！汕頭魚丸香脆彈牙，採用甚麼魚製作？且看師傅施展拍打功絕技，炮製雪白圓滿手打魚丸糖妹亦有樣學樣，鬼馬巧製老人丸孝敬輝哥！潮汕打冷堪稱潮式快餐，林林總總的海鮮生熟美食鹵水小吃多達四百餘種；輝哥還順道細說兒時吃潮州粥的艱難日子
阿爺廚房 (Sr.3) 18 鼎爺與阿譚清早來到逢簡河畔，探究順德河鮮肥美鮮甜的因由二人吃過馳名順德魚粥後意猶未盡，鼎爺選用大魚魚頭，炮製據稱有去頭風療效的川芎白芷天麻燉魚頭湯，箇中美味連阿譚亦食指大動！及後烹調的荷葉蒸雞同樣用料十足，除了用上蟲草花冬菇雲耳紅棗，鼎爺還特別以乾荷葉與新鮮荷葉包着雞項蒸煮，成品究竟有多滋味？挑選刀具要講究，去除魚腥泥味亦有學問，鼎爺於示範期間逐一公開他的私房烹飪心得
阿爺廚房 (Sr.3) 19 順德大良以飼養水牛聞名，以水牛奶做成的牛乳和雙皮奶，奶味尤其香濃鼎爺帶阿譚見識手工牛乳的製作工序後煮意大發，巧製鮮甜滋味的牛乳鯇片粥，自製鍋巴夾牛乳則香脆可口鍋巴怎樣才可炸得鬆化？阿譚手癢試炸，卻成了錯誤示範！海南雞飯雞滑飯香，加上雞雜煮白菜湯，可謂完美配搭！鼎爺堅持選用新鮮黃薑入飯，它比黃薑粉有何優勝之處？此外，不論雪藏雞或冰鮮雞，均可煮出鼎級海南雞飯，關鍵又在哪裡？

阿爺廚房 (Sr.3) 19 順德大良以飼養水牛聞名，以水牛奶做成的牛乳和雙皮奶，奶味尤其香濃鼎爺帶阿譚見識手工牛乳的製作工序後煮意大發，巧製鮮甜滋味的牛乳鯇片粥，自製鍋巴夾牛乳則香脆可口鍋巴怎樣才可炸得鬆化？阿譚手癢試炸，卻成了錯誤示範！海南雞飯雞滑飯香，加上雞雜煮白菜湯，可謂完美配搭！鼎爺堅持選用新鮮黃薑入飯，它比黃薑粉有何優勝之處？此外，不論雪藏雞或冰鮮雞，均可煮出鼎級海南雞飯，關鍵又在哪裡？
阿爺廚房 (Sr.3) 20 順德人愛用陳皮入饌，鼎爺帶阿譚到當地享用滋陰補腎靚湯陳皮燉青頭鴨，還傳授?柑皮的技巧，並講解青柑皮與紅柑皮的分別鼎爺購入特級陳皮，配合蝦仁火鴨鹹蛋黃等豐富食材，奉上功夫菜陳皮八寶鴨陳皮香味滲透米鴨內外，美味昇華為令蝦仁更爽口，鼎爺還以細膩刀功去掉蝦衣！深入工場一探布包豆腐的製作過程之後，鼎爺又有新煮意！生拆蟹鉗蒸豆腐配搭巧妙，鮮甜味美要將生蟹鉗拆肉，有甚麼技巧？
香港原味道 (Sr.5) 14 蛋卷店負責人為子女創業，創作不同口味的蛋卷製作過程用料一絲不苟，負責人除了精選優質雞蛋，還專程購買新鮮椰汁，堅持新鮮製作頌鵬初試捲蛋卷，成品如何？主持再到位於西貢的魚排，品嚐以生猛金錢斑與金頭鯛炮製的菜式，魚排設24小時水質監測系統，給香港人優質海魚有自動販賣機售賣健康為本的中式飯糰，庭鋒天佑到工場體驗製作工序！今集派出農耕男孩庭鋒正峰天佑上山採野生茅根，他們能鋤得滿意的收成嗎？
香港原味道 (Sr.5) 15 室內養殖魚場引入澳洲國寶魚墨瑞鱈魚，奈何疫情令魚滯銷，但無阻場主向港人推廣的決心，還即席炮製墨瑞鱈魚三食讓主持品嚐！大廚黃亞保在疫境下鑽研即食餸包，令繁忙都市人能輕易品嚐陳皮紅豆沙客家燜腩仔等功夫美食，方便快捷主持化身收割員採收本地水稻，亦不忘品嚐本地米原味道，象尖米元朗大棠絲苗的形狀質感有何不同？今集派出頌鵬德賢走進本地養豬場，完成幫黑毛豬沖涼餵奶等任務，順道認識優質本地黑毛豬

香港原味道 (Sr.5) 15 室內養殖魚場引入澳洲國寶魚墨瑞鱈魚，奈何疫情令魚滯銷，但無阻場主向港人推廣的決心，還即席炮製墨瑞鱈魚三食讓主持品嚐！大廚黃亞保在疫境下鑽研即食餸包，令繁忙都市人能輕易品嚐陳皮紅豆沙客家燜腩仔等功夫美食，方便快捷主持化身收割員採收本地水稻，亦不忘品嚐本地米原味道，象尖米元朗大棠絲苗的形狀質感有何不同？今集派出頌鵬德賢走進本地養豬場，完成幫黑毛豬沖涼餵奶等任務，順道認識優質本地黑毛豬
阿爺廚房 (Sr.3) 18 鼎爺與阿譚清早來到逢簡河畔，探究順德河鮮肥美鮮甜的因由二人吃過馳名順德魚粥後意猶未盡，鼎爺選用大魚魚頭，炮製據稱有去頭風療效的川芎白芷天麻燉魚頭湯，箇中美味連阿譚亦食指大動！及後烹調的荷葉蒸雞同樣用料十足，除了用上蟲草花冬菇雲耳紅棗，鼎爺還特別以乾荷葉與新鮮荷葉包着雞項蒸煮，成品究竟有多滋味？挑選刀具要講究，去除魚腥泥味亦有學問，鼎爺於示範期間逐一公開他的私房烹飪心得
阿爺廚房 (Sr.3) 19 順德大良以飼養水牛聞名，以水牛奶做成的牛乳和雙皮奶，奶味尤其香濃鼎爺帶阿譚見識手工牛乳的製作工序後煮意大發，巧製鮮甜滋味的牛乳鯇片粥，自製鍋巴夾牛乳則香脆可口鍋巴怎樣才可炸得鬆化？阿譚手癢試炸，卻成了錯誤示範！海南雞飯雞滑飯香，加上雞雜煮白菜湯，可謂完美配搭！鼎爺堅持選用新鮮黃薑入飯，它比黃薑粉有何優勝之處？此外，不論雪藏雞或冰鮮雞，均可煮出鼎級海南雞飯，關鍵又在哪裡？
阿爺廚房 (Sr.3) 21 品嚐靚牛肉不單要認清來源地，不同牛隻部位亦各有滋味，位於汕頭的一條龍火鍋店到底有何美味過人之處？日本和牛被奉為上等食材，鼎爺卻認為本地黃牛絕不失禮，遂以同樣配料分別搭配和牛黃牛，炮製出兩道三色炒牛肉，吃盡兩地牛肉風味愛吃牛肉的鼎爺原來曾戒牛24年，背後只因一個承諾！潮州芥蘭份外鮮嫩，品種亦多荷塘芥蘭紅腳芥蘭的處理方法不盡相同，鼎爺藉着方魚炒芥蘭菜式打孖上，詳述當中烹調要訣
阿爺廚房 (Sr.3) 22 糖蔥餅是不少港人的兒時小食來到據稱是糖蔥餅發源地的汕頭陳店鎮福潭村，鼎爺帶阿譚一睹只用砂糖與麥芽糖的糖蔥餅製作工序，餅中的孔洞竟是靠師傅徒手拉出！返回廚房，鼎爺巧製以砂糖當主角的潮式甜品反沙芋，還加入芝麻與芫荽做出變奏版，甜中多添一分香味二人又往衡山市場尋找攤檔西施，可有收穫？要煮出皮肉軟腍的鹹菜黃豆燜豬手，關火焗煮才是關鍵！試吃期間，鼎爺教拍檔品嚐菜式的極品位，會是甚麼？
阿爺廚房 (Sr.3) 23 潮州人愛食潮州粥，還用各款配菜伴吃，主持們再訪汕頭衡山市場，介紹醃海瓜子烏欖黃泥螺鹹菜等地道配菜；另會一探欖菜的製作工序欖菜煮法多，炒飯炒菜伴粥皆宜鼎爺炮製欖菜肉碎乾煸四季豆期間，阿譚卻多多聲氣，遂故意跟她鬥氣，令這道惹味菜式增添一分趣味鼎爺及後奉上的菊花龍躉內外兼備，想必讓嘴刁一族心花怒放花尾龍躉起肉並切成菊花狀，講求細膩刀功；魚肉下鑊油炸原來亦有技巧！留意鼎爺教路
輝哥為食遊 2 輝哥偕同糖妹直闖家鄉汕頭達濠，品嚐不是飯的魚飯這道風味菜把鮮魚放於一盤盤的竹籬內用魚湯蒸浸至熟，再待涼凍吃九棍魚對潮州人別具意義，作為魚飯擺放還有特定儀式輝哥初試牛鰍魚飯，蘸以普寧豆醬，入口肥美！汕頭蠔餅外脆內嫩，師傅以多年功力示範蠔烙的半浮煎法；輝哥糖妹急不及待在街頭享用爆漿蠔餅二人接着品嚐真正蠔宴，全方位品味蠔煲鐵板蠔蠔羹炸蠔烤蠔鹹醃等八款蠔菜的煮法
輝哥為食遊 3 汕頭獅頭鵝肉質優良，被奉為潮式鹵水鵝正宗輝哥糖妹到訪鵝場，負責人推介鵝的最矜貴食用部位竟是鵝冠？二人急不及待品嚐鹵水鵝片鵝肝掌翼，肥美得令人垂涎一碟老鵝頭，友情價更要八百大元！佛山一家主打豬雜粥的食店，每晚坐滿對新鮮豬雜引頸以待的客人，只為一嚐風味生滾粥順德美食陳村粉薄爽滑軟，糖妹參觀製作過程之餘，還親製粉卷孝敬輝哥陳村粉不論煎焗醬炒，或配以牛腩進食，爽滑不變
輝哥為食遊 4 順德名菜均安蒸豬，以豬原隻去骨醃製，經古法蒸煮而成，當中蘊含當地人的體貼孝心肉質爽而不膩，有何秘訣？甚麼部位是必吃推介？輝哥糖妹還太公分豬肉，與眾分甘同味順德農家菜簡樸鮮味，泡菜燜魚骨椰青浸鰂魚，傳統中顯創意！輝哥講故，大談扣肉起源沙溪扣肉的獨特香味則源自地道蔞葉，而五花肉先炸後蒸，夾以芋頭粉葛，晶瑩剔透，令人食指大動沙溪獨家皮膠鴨，豬皮吸盡燜鴨真味，更要先嚐為快

阿爺廚房 (Sr.3) 21 品嚐靚牛肉不單要認清來源地，不同牛隻部位亦各有滋味，位於汕頭的一條龍火鍋店到底有何美味過人之處？日本和牛被奉為上等食材，鼎爺卻認為本地黃牛絕不失禮，遂以同樣配料分別搭配和牛黃牛，炮製出兩道三色炒牛肉，吃盡兩地牛肉風味愛吃牛肉的鼎爺原來曾戒牛24年，背後只因一個承諾！潮州芥蘭份外鮮嫩，品種亦多荷塘芥蘭紅腳芥蘭的處理方法不盡相同，鼎爺藉着方魚炒芥蘭菜式打孖上，詳述當中烹調要訣
阿爺廚房 (Sr.3) 22 糖蔥餅是不少港人的兒時小食來到據稱是糖蔥餅發源地的汕頭陳店鎮福潭村，鼎爺帶阿譚一睹只用砂糖與麥芽糖的糖蔥餅製作工序，餅中的孔洞竟是靠師傅徒手拉出！返回廚房，鼎爺巧製以砂糖當主角的潮式甜品反沙芋，還加入芝麻與芫荽做出變奏版，甜中多添一分香味二人又往衡山市場尋找攤檔西施，可有收穫？要煮出皮肉軟腍的鹹菜黃豆燜豬手，關火焗煮才是關鍵！試吃期間，鼎爺教拍檔品嚐菜式的極品位，會是甚麼？
阿爺廚房 (Sr.3) 23 潮州人愛食潮州粥，還用各款配菜伴吃，主持們再訪汕頭衡山市場，介紹醃海瓜子烏欖黃泥螺鹹菜等地道配菜；另會一探欖菜的製作工序欖菜煮法多，炒飯炒菜伴粥皆宜鼎爺炮製欖菜肉碎乾煸四季豆期間，阿譚卻多多聲氣，遂故意跟她鬥氣，令這道惹味菜式增添一分趣味鼎爺及後奉上的菊花龍躉內外兼備，想必讓嘴刁一族心花怒放花尾龍躉起肉並切成菊花狀，講求細膩刀功；魚肉下鑊油炸原來亦有技巧！留意鼎爺教路
輝哥為食遊 2 輝哥偕同糖妹直闖家鄉汕頭達濠，品嚐不是飯的魚飯這道風味菜把鮮魚放於一盤盤的竹籬內用魚湯蒸浸至熟，再待涼凍吃九棍魚對潮州人別具意義，作為魚飯擺放還有特定儀式輝哥初試牛鰍魚飯，蘸以普寧豆醬，入口肥美！汕頭蠔餅外脆內嫩，師傅以多年功力示範蠔烙的半浮煎法；輝哥糖妹急不及待在街頭享用爆漿蠔餅二人接着品嚐真正蠔宴，全方位品味蠔煲鐵板蠔蠔羹炸蠔烤蠔鹹醃等八款蠔菜的煮法

輝哥為食遊 2 輝哥偕同糖妹直闖家鄉汕頭達濠，品嚐不是飯的魚飯這道風味菜把鮮魚放於一盤盤的竹籬內用魚湯蒸浸至熟，再待涼凍吃九棍魚對潮州人別具意義，作為魚飯擺放還有特定儀式輝哥初試牛鰍魚飯，蘸以普寧豆醬，入口肥美！汕頭蠔餅外脆內嫩，師傅以多年功力示範蠔烙的半浮煎法；輝哥糖妹急不及待在街頭享用爆漿蠔餅二人接着品嚐真正蠔宴，全方位品味蠔煲鐵板蠔蠔羹炸蠔烤蠔鹹醃等八款蠔菜的煮法
輝哥為食遊 3 汕頭獅頭鵝肉質優良，被奉為潮式鹵水鵝正宗輝哥糖妹到訪鵝場，負責人推介鵝的最矜貴食用部位竟是鵝冠？二人急不及待品嚐鹵水鵝片鵝肝掌翼，肥美得令人垂涎一碟老鵝頭，友情價更要八百大元！佛山一家主打豬雜粥的食店，每晚坐滿對新鮮豬雜引頸以待的客人，只為一嚐風味生滾粥順德美食陳村粉薄爽滑軟，糖妹參觀製作過程之餘，還親製粉卷孝敬輝哥陳村粉不論煎焗醬炒，或配以牛腩進食，爽滑不變
輝哥為食遊 4 順德名菜均安蒸豬，以豬原隻去骨醃製，經古法蒸煮而成，當中蘊含當地人的體貼孝心肉質爽而不膩，有何秘訣？甚麼部位是必吃推介？輝哥糖妹還太公分豬肉，與眾分甘同味順德農家菜簡樸鮮味，泡菜燜魚骨椰青浸鰂魚，傳統中顯創意！輝哥講故，大談扣肉起源沙溪扣肉的獨特香味則源自地道蔞葉，而五花肉先炸後蒸，夾以芋頭粉葛，晶瑩剔透，令人食指大動沙溪獨家皮膠鴨，豬皮吸盡燜鴨真味，更要先嚐為快
阿爺廚房 (Sr.3) 21 品嚐靚牛肉不單要認清來源地，不同牛隻部位亦各有滋味，位於汕頭的一條龍火鍋店到底有何美味過人之處？日本和牛被奉為上等食材，鼎爺卻認為本地黃牛絕不失禮，遂以同樣配料分別搭配和牛黃牛，炮製出兩道三色炒牛肉，吃盡兩地牛肉風味愛吃牛肉的鼎爺原來曾戒牛24年，背後只因一個承諾！潮州芥蘭份外鮮嫩，品種亦多荷塘芥蘭紅腳芥蘭的處理方法不盡相同，鼎爺藉着方魚炒芥蘭菜式打孖上，詳述當中烹調要訣

鬼宮 第16集 尹甲是首爾出身的奎章閣檢書官，以良好的聲譽和英俊的外表而聞名有一天，他的身體被惡神姜哲附身他體內的惡神與曾經暗戀過尹甲的汝里有著連結汝里是一位著名巫師的唯一孫女她擁有精神天賦，但她拒絕成為靈媒，而是成為一名玻璃匠 惡神需要汝里的屍體才能升天，但汝里拒絕了尹甲被附身後，汝里進入了宮殿，那裡有強大的女鬼和惡靈所困擾

野地黑幫 幫派不是人類獨有的特色, 在動物界隨處可見有朋友撐腰, 不管是保護家園尋覓食物爭奪配偶學習求生技能, 甚至是宣戰, 一切都會變得比較輕鬆
搶救英國野生動物 第1季第9集 民眾發現一隻青少年期的天鵝, 不斷遭受父母欺負驅趕, 於是通報專員前來救助
小動物狠角色 第1季第11集 嬌小的動物雖然不太起眼, 但有些狠角色卻擁有令人大開眼界的超強能力本集節目要介紹的是馬達加斯加雨林裡的低地馬島條紋蝟牠可說是地球上最特別的哺乳動物了, 低地馬島條紋蝟的屁股上有一小搓又粗又短的尖刺, 互相敲擊的時候會發出人類聽不見的高頻率聲波, 藉此把訊息傳遍整座雨林, 和其他低地馬島條紋蝟進行溝通
野地大膽王 第1季第7集 卡悠提前往澳洲, 找尋獨樹一格的守宮澳洲有超過六百種蜥蜴, 其中將近三分之一是守宮
爬蟲偵探 第1季第3集 緬甸乾燥的蒲甘平原是爬蟲學家納森尼爾這次旅程的起點這座平原上有三千多座寺廟, 納森尼爾在這裡抓到了俗稱飛蛇的美麗金花蛇, 還有俗稱軟殼龜的緬甸箱鱉接著他到博彬區, 找到了世界第二大的蜥蜴: 澤巨蜥最後他在竹林裡遇到世界上最毒的蛇類, 眼鏡王蛇, 為百科全書資料收集之旅畫上完美的句點
蘇格蘭:守護野生動物 第1季第2集 本集介紹協會的臥底小組, 他們負責調查與動物有關的犯罪活動, 這次臥底小組根據情報, 要突襲農場, 尋找致命的毒物
百變爬蟲箱 第1季第3集 一家刺青店的夫妻, 由於長時間待在店裡, 所以希望把家裡的公蚺和母蚺帶來店裡養, 接著索性想請康乃爾世界幫他們打造兩個搶眼的爬蟲箱, 一個在櫃檯下面, 讓每個顧客進門都可以看到搶眼的公巨蚺；另一個大爬蟲箱放在等候坐位區, 讓顧客可以在自拍時, 拿巨蚺當背景康乃爾在櫃台前設計的爬蟲箱裡面, 放了日本武士刀, 模擬自然棲地的樹木, 讓公蚺可以在上面爬另一個爬蟲箱則設計成日式寶塔, 裡面放樹枝拼出大的大樹, 背景是鮮豔的風格, 映襯出白子母蚺的形態這兩個爬蟲箱令刺青店夫妻和顧客都讚不絕口
德州保育戰 第5季第13集 在本集節目中, 德州漁獵巡警來到美墨邊境的河流, 遇上想渡河非法入境美國的移民民眾投訴鄰居非法租賃土地給獵人狩獵, 危害到她一家人的安全一名男子被控將拖車開進狩獵俱樂部土地棄置, 可能被告非法闖入和傾倒最後漁獵巡警在路上偶遇一場車禍, 下車確認民眾安全
貓咪101 第3季第5集 在美國估計每天有4萬隻小貓出生, 牠們有各種想像得到的顏色和斑紋每隻在出生時都有可愛的大眼睛, 專為撥動你的心弦而演化成型, 牠們變得可愛是一種求生優勢, 擁有大眼睛和相對較短的鼻子, 可愛會吸引牠們的媽咪, 也會吸引我們, 所以我們天生喜歡小貓小狗嬰兒小鳥和所有年幼動物但是在這裡面小貓排名第一本集將教你注意如何挑選適合你家庭生活型態的小貓, 以及帶新小貓進家門之前應該要添購哪些東西, 以及如何為家裡做好貓咪防護措施, 來迎接未來15到20年與貓咪共同生活的精采時光
動物百分百 第2季第5集 昆蟲在地球上發現的生物中至少佔了8成, 是唯一有翅膀的無脊椎動物, 牠們最擅長的就是求生
動物求生高手 第1季第3集 本片展示各種色彩斑斕行為浮誇的奇特物種, 探索牠們如何利用炫目的外表奪下最奪目生物的頭銜
野地贏家 第1季第3集 地球上住著很多種靈長類, 在人煙罕至的雪山, 住著緬甸金絲猴, 牠們得想辦法熬過寒冷的冬天；日本的獼猴為了抵禦寒冬, 聰明地泡在溫泉裡；衣索比亞高原的獅尾狒, 沒有捍衛地盤的觀念, 如果吃的東西夠多, 還能好幾群狒狒一起住；南美的毛蜘蛛猴是一種奇特的猴子, 牠們一生幾乎都住在樹上, 而且沒有階級之分, 黑猩猩除了手指靈活, 也有明顯的智慧, 牠們利用工具, 解決生活上的不便；還有跟人類生活在一起的猴子, 泰國的三峰塔會為猴子準備盛宴, 讓牠們飽餐一頓靈長類是個聰明又多樣化的家族, 牠們跟人類的共同點也許超過我們的想像

小動物狠角色 第1季第11集 嬌小的動物雖然不太起眼, 但有些狠角色卻擁有令人大開眼界的超強能力本集節目要介紹的是馬達加斯加雨林裡的低地馬島條紋蝟牠可說是地球上最特別的哺乳動物了, 低地馬島條紋蝟的屁股上有一小搓又粗又短的尖刺, 互相敲擊的時候會發出人類聽不見的高頻率聲波, 藉此把訊息傳遍整座雨林, 和其他低地馬島條紋蝟進行溝通

熱血獸醫師 第4季第5集 在科羅拉多州一般人可以合法地把豬當寵物飼養, 近年來由於所謂的新品種迷你豬, 茶杯豬或袖珍豬紛紛誕生, 養寵物豬也逐漸蔚為風潮, 很多人把小豬買回家, 以為每天餵食飼料但是豬卻不會長大, 殊不知小豬竟日漸肥胖, 轉眼之間就完全失控變成幾十公斤甚至上百斤的大肥豬, 於是又有越來越多人棄養豬隻, 在整個丹佛都會區, 流浪豬無人聞問更無收容所可去, 直到艾琳成立豬隻避風港這個非營利救援組織, 豬隻才脫離受虐和被棄養的命運, 終於有了一個安身之處, 這個救援組織的終極目標是要為豬隻找到最好的歸宿, 他們的策略之一就是要先為所有的豬隻絕育, 因為這樣豬隻到了發情期才不會逞兇鬥狠, 也比較容易成為大家能接受的寵物, 但是由於組織的資金完全來自於捐款, 他們的費用多半都用在豬隻的飼料和醫療上, 沒有多餘的經費來做豬隻傳染病的預防, 寵物計畫診所的貝爾醫師獲悉這個情況, 就主動前往豬隻收容所義務出診, 果
炙熱非洲 第1季第1集 莽原上的獅子想在夜晚狩獵, 但牠們平常鎖定的獵物都在白日活動, 所以牠們只能頂著高溫, 和獵物搏鬥

鱷魚拍檔這一家 第3季第7集 澳洲是無尾熊的故鄉, 但澳洲的無尾熊正處於危急存亡之秋隨著人口的增加, 無尾熊遇到的挑戰也愈來愈多牠們會遭到狗攻擊, 會被汽車撞上更有數以萬計的無尾熊, 死於最近的澳洲叢林大火此外, 野生無尾熊還要面對另一個重大威脅, 也就是披衣菌疾病披衣菌疾病是一種嚴重的細菌感染, 它是於交配季在無尾熊之間傳染無尾熊如果沒有接受治療, 可能因此失明這次澳洲動物園接到一對無尾熊母子, 其中的媽媽無尾熊的眼睛有嚴重的披衣菌感染但牠在接受治療後, 順利和兒子一起被野放了
德州保育戰 第5季第15集 在泰勒郡, 小牛從圍籬破口跑出來, 漁獵巡警順手修好圍籬鹿鞭受傷的小鹿沒有外傷, 讓牠自行痊癒兩個青少年到荒郊野外喝啤酒抽菸, 漁獵巡警用自身成長經驗曉以大義在南帕德雷島, 國慶日當天晚上有煙火表演, 海上人船眾多, 特別加強水上安檢, 一對吵架夫棄被帶往牢裡過夜在加耳維斯敦, 一如往常, 釣魚沒有釣魚證, 漁獲尺寸過小是常見違規一輛水上摩托車下水後沉了, 漁獵巡警接獲通知趕去, 落水者已經被海岸防衛隊救上船在波特郡, 一隻密西西比鳶受傷了, 被送往復健中心, 可惜傷重不治一隻麋鹿在公路上被撞, 漁獵巡警趕去處理時卻不翼而飛有人飼養特殊綿羊, 卻被誤會成違法飼養白尾鹿在傑弗孫郡, 有人騎水上摩托車沒穿救生衣

鱷魚拍檔這一家 第3季第9集 賓蒂和錢德勒前往大堡礁的艾略特夫人島, 了解氣候變遷造成何種衝擊該地二月時發生珊瑚白化事件, 成因是海水的溫度持續升高, 導致珊瑚內的藻類離去, 結果珊瑚失去所有的顏色, 慢慢死亡珊瑚白化時並未死亡, 還有些時間等藻類回來, 所以只要白化後海溫冷卻下來的速度夠快, 珊瑚便能復原吉力是公科摩多巨蜥, 遠從歐洲布拉格而來, 園方要介紹牠跟母蜥英妲認識, 希望能順利推動繁殖計畫穆拉坎保育園區發現窩瑪蟒潔西出了問題, 牠體重過輕, 脖子有異物卡住, 獸醫幫牠醫治, 讓牠恢復正常進食

蝙蝠傳奇 楚留香與一點紅自從在神水宮殺大破無花和尚后,又回到中原結識了李玉函與柳無眉在此之前,楚曾遇到連串莫名其妙的事情,後來,楚才知柳身患宿疾,她需要以楚的人頭到蝙蝠島去換取一種藥物治病,是以欲置楚於死地,楚親往蝙蝠島了解事件,才驚覺陰謀中又有陰謀
舞衣 歌星白眉有一豪宅,與空姐朱黛舞女姚姚同住,三女各有愛情際遇;白眉雖愛錢,卻傾情自稱從外地來的路俊,兩人只好互許後會有期之願;朱黛曾迷戀已婚飛機師,分手後又愛上賽車手;姚姚的最大心願是把清白之軀留給丈夫,她本最愛窮工人李吉,李吉卻因自卑而忍痛分手,姚姚嫁予富家子,卻仍掛念李吉...

獵魔者 巨富之女賀盈聘請羅力到柬埔寨,從殺手乃汶處奪回商業秘密錄音帶羅與好友組織一支敢死隊,直赴游擊隊基地,成功將錄音帶交到賀手上後,方發現背後原來有極大的密秘...
弟子也瘋狂 方世玉洪熙官與胡惠乾三位俗家弟子初入少林,拜於南院戒嗔大師門下習武然而,三人常與出家弟子悟清較勁切磋,寺中從此喧嚷不絕,連方丈見此情景亦不免啼笑皆非
遊俠情 杜孟飛奉命下山闖蕩江湖,途中救出遭黑道中人捉拿的沐婉兒,杜挺身相救,沐萬分感激未幾,杜又救出被黑道中人圍攻的少女李賽男及後,杜無意中得知一段二十年前的江湖恩怨,黑道首領是李之殺父仇人,而沐則是黑道首領失散的女兒
魚美人 張珍與金寵之女牡丹早有婚約,金寵卻欲退婚張珍偶遇化身金牡丹樣子的鯉魚精,兩人漸生情愫一天,金寵請包公來公斷兩個真假牡丹,包公為成全二人,推辭此案
御貓三戲錦毛鼠 展昭白玉堂武功不相上下白一次無意中救了皇帝獲嘉封,卻不相信其身份,揚長而去後皇帝再遇險,被展所救,展即獲御封白不忿設計盜去玉璽,欲戲弄展,幸展武功高強,終不辱皇命而回
狂戀詩 大偉和小春是同胞兄弟,一個放浪,一個含蓄小春在舞會邂逅女子珠迪,情心一片大偉發現珠迪有個年老丈夫,得知此秘密,大偉以此威脅,迫珠迪和他幽會,自始珠迪周旋三個男人之間... 導演以女性角度大膽描寫男女情關,手法細膩,而結局亦出人意表
倚天屠龍記 元朝時,武林中人都在爭奪倚天劍屠龍刀這兩件武林神器;兩件神器只需一併在手,方可找出秘密,雄霸天下張無忌機緣巧合下練得九陽神功,因此也捲入了這場紛爭百年的武林是非中
兒女是我們的 富家小姐梅淑卿與窮教師江少文,為了自由戀愛,脫離父母,從城市遷往小鎮結婚生活他們生育五個兒女,但生存的擔子日重,二人長期辛勞,終相繼亡故小兒女頓失庇蔭,直接面對複雜的社會,幾乎各散東西
土匪 少女林曉虹因父母雙亡,只得投奔她的舅父方振權方振權是鄉下土財主,膝下有二子,長子方正勇敢正直;次子方風則好賭成性,喜拈花惹草某日,風 在方家花園裡,方風發現有一少女,乘她不防上前擁抱,少女竭力抗拒,方正聞聲趕來,方風才知道少女就是表妹林曉虹然方風色心未退

死角 故事描述,狄龍與姜大衛游車河時,遇富家女李菁的跑車拋錨,狄載她返家,一見鍾情後李往姜之修車廠取車,再遇狄,狄約李去跳舞,夜總會中,碰見李兄陳鴻烈,陳不喜歡狄,故二人只好提早離去;歸家途中,目擊員警追捕逃犯,逃犯掉下之手槍,被狄檢到,從此改變他的命?..
神刀 神刀大俠臨終時,把神刀傳給了徒弟林振嘯,而且更識破了另一徒弟方世雄為奪神刀而混入門下的奸計方世雄為了神刀,令林家破人亡和雙目失明最後,林振嘯與方世雄大戰為家人報仇,並誓要重奪神刀
武松 一次醉酒後,武松赤手空拳打死一隻猛虎,因此被任命為都頭武松兄長武大郎的妻子潘金蓮色誘武松,但遭他拒絕後來,潘金蓮和富戶西門慶有染,及後姦情敗露,兩人繼而毒死了武大郎武松知悉後,先殺潘金蓮再殺西門慶,為兄長報仇

南少林與北少林 滿清入主中原後,北少林為免遭剿滅,只好受命派出弟子到清軍府擔任教頭,誰知抵達後,始知府中已有南少林教頭;期間將軍挑動兩派人不和繼而公開比武互相殘殺,後南派因弟子傷亡而與北派交惡,展開一番互相殘殺...

六指琴魔 女俠風靈得悉六弦魔琴重現江湖,唯一能克制魔琴的只有火弦弓及火羽箭,唯袖手樵隱知其下落;風找得群雄一起找樵;期間,眾人發現逍遙隱士就是六指琴魔...

大灣區會客廳 大灣區會客廳是深圳衛視一檔聚焦調查研究的中英雙語訪談欄目, 定位全球灣區視角, 捕捉前沿趨勢, 聚焦中國與世界的經貿交流科技創新文化時尚等板塊, 通過一線調研, 對話政企界領軍人物科技大咖文化名家等, 展現中外科技成果經貿交往趨勢文明交流互鑒節目開播兩年多, 已推出過百期專訪 節目將國內外熱點新聞人物內嵌入大灣區, 訪談嘉賓或結合自身在灣區生活工作的經歷, 或從專業角度闡述對灣區發展的看法, 以微觀的個體敘事切入大灣區風雲激蕩波瀾壯闊的宏大敘事, 展現灣區發展戰略給所有人帶來的時代機遇 同時節目還以大灣區內部以及對外的要素流動, 作為行進中對話的沉浸式體驗場景, 讓受訪者充分共情, 以研究熱點剖析熱點問題意識來解構節目, 展現粵港澳大灣區處處是變局與新局 節目還重點關注粵港澳大灣區與全球灣區的聯動, 從中外創新交流資金要素流動人才流通等領域,

大灣區會客廳 大灣區會客廳是深圳衛視一檔聚焦調查研究的中英雙語訪談欄目, 定位全球灣區視角, 捕捉前沿趨勢, 聚焦中國與世界的經貿交流科技創新文化時尚等板塊, 通過一線調研, 對話政企界領軍人物科技大咖文化名家等, 展現中外科技成果經貿交往趨勢文明交流互鑒節目開播兩年多, 已推出過百期專訪 節目將國內外熱點新聞人物內嵌入大灣區, 訪談嘉賓或結合自身在灣區生活工作的經歷, 或從專業角度闡述對灣區發展的看法, 以微觀的個體敘事切入大灣區風雲激蕩波瀾壯闊的宏大敘事, 展現灣區發展戰略給所有人帶來的時代機遇 同時節目還以大灣區內部以及對外的要素流動, 作為行進中對話的沉浸式體驗場景, 讓受訪者充分共情, 以研究熱點剖析熱點問題意識來解構節目, 展現粵港澳大灣區處處是變局與新局 節目還重點關注粵港澳大灣區與全球灣區的聯動, 從中外創新交流資金要素流動人才流通等領域,

大灣區會客廳 大灣區會客廳是深圳衛視一檔聚焦調查研究的中英雙語訪談欄目, 定位全球灣區視角, 捕捉前沿趨勢, 聚焦中國與世界的經貿交流科技創新文化時尚等板塊, 通過一線調研, 對話政企界領軍人物科技大咖文化名家等, 展現中外科技成果經貿交往趨勢文明交流互鑒節目開播兩年多, 已推出過百期專訪 節目將國內外熱點新聞人物內嵌入大灣區, 訪談嘉賓或結合自身在灣區生活工作的經歷, 或從專業角度闡述對灣區發展的看法, 以微觀的個體敘事切入大灣區風雲激蕩波瀾壯闊的宏大敘事, 展現灣區發展戰略給所有人帶來的時代機遇 同時節目還以大灣區內部以及對外的要素流動, 作為行進中對話的沉浸式體驗場景, 讓受訪者充分共情, 以研究熱點剖析熱點問題意識來解構節目, 展現粵港澳大灣區處處是變局與新局 節目還重點關注粵港澳大灣區與全球灣區的聯動, 從中外創新交流資金要素流動人才流通等領域,

兩仔爺 畢均與歌女李小娟兩情相悅，兩人欲為托兒所籌款，均施計騙父，騙得金錢以作義演，因此遭父逐出家門均母惦念兒子，均父遂懸賞尋子，均為領賞再次騙父，又託辭要與娟結婚，希望為托兒所籌足經費，結果弄出重重誤會

我的鬼故事亞洲版 第4集 一名男子被一個幽靈舔了一下；馬來西亞小姐蘇盈之在出演了一部恐怖電視劇後開始受到靈異力量的侵擾；一個慘遭謀殺的慢跑者陰魂不散

宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈3[粵] 善良的幸如，活於丈夫施繼威的壓榨下，罹患絕症她撞破丈夫與唯一閨蜜潘雪文的姦情，爭執間被推出馬路慘遭車撞然而，幸如突然醒來，發現一切似乎只是場夢但當夢中場景接連應驗，她意識到這或是預知夢為改寫命運，幸如決心扭轉夢中的悲劇幸如不僅要擺脫渣男與假閨蜜，更設法撮合二人，讓雪文接手其原本的不幸她又善用夢境記憶換上亮麗外型，在職場力爭上游，還和並肩作戰的上司葉家謙漸生情愫，最終開拓幸福人生！
宏利保險呈獻：重症解密[粵] 節目鎖定不同重症，以深入淺出的方式道出頑疾成因病理機制最新治療方案和預防方法譚俊彥陳曉華林秀怡梁凱晴化身重症調查科調查員，四出搜羅線索證物證人，務求解開各種致命危疾的重重疑團來自香港各大公立與私家醫院，及本地大學醫學院的資深醫生與學者，結合真實病例醫療影像，令複雜的醫學知識變得貼地，讓大眾更全面認知重症的診治過程，減少誤解與恐懼，也鼓勵港人及早檢查及時治療，守護健康未來

再創世紀17[粵][PG] 麗瞳動議撤換主席，天生率先支持，讓定垚看清其真面目投票之際，啟堂突然出現思妤收到太陽花以為是高哲所送，沒想到是追求者定垚得知父親心臟病發真相，報警求助程凱再次從小慧身上得到靈感，決定研發智能家居，成功獲得董事注資令翹向明晞推銷自己，明晞要她查探學禮有何動作明晞估計學禮想參與能源項目，天生決定插手分一杯羹天生宣布出讓傲堂股份，啟堂私下詢問高哲會否跟自己爭奪定垚驚悉內地發展部集體辭職

婆媽女婿 4 [粵] 志威帶朋友回家打麻雀至通宵眾人離去後，志威喚醒志信商討頂讓車房一事，翌晨更請他喝茶，並提出借貸九萬志信回家問志威拿回借款不果志信因工作遲到，未能及時趕到婚姻註冊處，與穎茵吵大架志威特意帶同數名艷女共膳，志信感不自然，並決定哄回穎茵志威專程打扮得西裝筆挺，以長兄身份與志信往見未來外父外母，期間多番大聲說話，志信多番按住，才不致出醜志威決定把錢退回給志信，志信接過支票細看下卻面色一沉.
懷念謝賢 : 鬼夜哭 1 [粵] 方濤在雨中遇上丁家女孩，後得知女孩原來是午夜嚎哭的亡靈，於是濤往丁園詢問門公，得悉丁家小姐秀華自殺離世，追查下，還從女鬼口中獲悉事件與華後母有關濤決為華討回公道，終讓幕後黑手道出謀財害命的真相
盞鬼老豆 19 [粵] 賈昭見淑賢與寶實決定過加拿大，對香港亦無甚留戀，答應了白老大上哈爾濱打理卡拉OK，此－去逗留兩年左右在淑賢上機當日，淑賢因心大心細，未能決定是否離開，竟表示若賈昭打電話來的話，便放棄赴加，寶寶得悉，便打電話四處找賈昭，可惜陰差陽錯之下，賈昭亦到學校及淑賢住所樓下，但始終未能鼓起勇氣見淑賢娉婷接了寶寶電話後，四出協助找賈昭，豈料賈昭支了上期薪水後，跑到娉婷家道別，並欲還錢與娉婷，二人未能相遇素梅回來復仇，竟捉了一心一意
民間傳奇 100 [粵] 民間傳奇把中國古代流傳下來近百個著名章回小說戲曲故事神話傳說等等搬上螢光幕，常描寫古代百姓的悲歡離合人生百態，堪稱電視史上中國民間故事的集大成者劇情大多包含警世意義，儘管故事的結局不一定大團圓，大致上歌頌人間的真善美，唾棄邪惡無義的行徑，奸惡之徒多數惡有惡報，每每大快人心！過去每逢過年過節都會抽出應景的故事播出，是至今仍未被超越的經典之作
婆媽女婿 3 [粵] 穎茵再次賴床而遲到，慧中吩咐她三日內走遍港九親界完成環保問卷調查穎茵外出工作時重遇舊同學娟，得知她已嫁工廠太子爺，回家向父母提及婚事，時志信剛巧至，國邦等追問禮金一事，惟志信蒙在鼓裡，只把加薪之所得交給未來外父外母，細談下才驚訝得知婚事志信用兄長座駕載穎茵走遍新界完成工作，得上司賞識而升為採訪主任志信正惆悵如何拒絕婚事，喜聞穎茵再次專注工作，帶同演唱會門票找她，豈料穎茵重提月底結婚
婆媽女婿 4 [粵] 志威帶朋友回家打麻雀至通宵眾人離去後，志威喚醒志信商討頂讓車房一事，翌晨更請他喝茶，並提出借貸九萬志信回家問志威拿回借款不果志信因工作遲到，未能及時趕到婚姻註冊處，與穎茵吵大架志威特意帶同數名艷女共膳，志信感不自然，並決定哄回穎茵志威專程打扮得西裝筆挺，以長兄身份與志信往見未來外父外母，期間多番大聲說話，志信多番按住，才不致出醜志威決定把錢退回給志信，志信接過支票細看下卻面色一沉.
萬家傳說 15 [粵] 德福欠下王鏢師賭債，迫於將大妹許配予其子潤發為妻，令德福大感為難大妹見潤發個性浮躁好色，未足托付終身，在作出決定之前，設法試探包金的心意包金雖對大妹鍾情，但眼見潤發浪子回頭，立誓婚後洗心革面，惟退出追求大妹，黯然祝福二人芊芊不忿柳姿長伴文通，決以身相許，向他大展迷惑之術她雖然無心加害文通，但畢竟人狐有別，令他大為耗損，日漸消瘦柳姿見文通終日精神恍惚，向他提出警告，奈何文通身不由己，每晚照去與芊芊幽會
再見十九歲 (數碼修復版) 14 [粵] 鄧寧突從英國返港，約禮知甚難擺脫她，故意對她態度冷淡，令鄧寧十分不滿鄧寧突到約禮家中，但約禮不在家，天佑乘機探問鄧寧與約禮之關係，證實鄧寧非其生母，但鄧寧聲言將與約禮結婚，令天佑大感不解約禮向鄧寧暗示感情已變，但鄧寧不甘就此放棄，決與約禮周旋到底約禮夾在Moon梁與鄧寧之間，弄至疲憊不堪，天佑見狀，雖感同情，但仍責怪約禮害己害人約禮因病未有上班，鄧寧與Moon梁不約而同到來探望，此時約禮已往看醫生，天佑忙替約禮掩飾，鄧寧已心知肚明，卻逼約禮與之結婚

Feng Qiao Jing Shi Ep24 This broad selection of drama series genres includes romance, military and family connections, captured in China's great classics.
Feng Qiao Jing Shi Ep25 This broad selection of drama series genres includes romance, military and family connections, captured in China's great classics.
King Gambler In this lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, two cardsharks spar in a battle of wits and fists to become king of the casino.
Black Magic 2 In this mind-blowing sequel to the Shaw Brothers' horror hit, zombies run amok, driving doctors to seek a natural cause while the actual one may be supernatural.
Flying Guillotine 2 The Emperor develops a more deadly Flying Guillotine and trains a squad of women to combat the 'Iron Umbrella' and a band of rebels.
Men From the Monastery The story of Shaolin firebrands Fang Shih-yu, Hung I-kuan, and Hu Huei-chien comes to life in Chang Cheh's rousing kung fu saga.
Monkey Kung Fu Director Ching Siu-tung won international acclaim for this tale of an underachiever who is assigned to unlock the secret of the gibbon fists tactic.
Shaolin Intruders Choreographed by Tang Chia, this film is an entertaining combination of eye-popping martial arts' moves and thrilling 'Sherlock Holmes' investigations. Stars Liu Yu Pu, Derek Yee.
Hong Kong 73 Families win and lose fortunes overnight while neighbours swindle each other as stock as speculation madness takes over Hong Kong.
The Long Chase The chase may be long, but the action is fast and furious, in this tale of a dart master-for-hire and the innkeeper's daughter who loves him.
Tropicana Interlude Take a vacation with sexy Lily Ho and Jimmy Lin Chong on a whirlwind tour of Southeast Asia in one of Shaw Brothers most lively 1960's musical romances.
The Sentimental Swordsman A virtuous lone swordsman who is not without individual weaknesses (Ti Lung) finally decides that it's payback time.
The Snake Prince Attracted by a sensual rain dance performed by three tribeswomen, three snake siblings set in motion a tale of romance, lust and tragedy.
The Fantastic Magic Baby Go on a quest with the Monkey King, Goddess of Mercy and Dragon Girl, as they battle Hung, the son of the Ox Demon to save Tang Tseng, the Holy Pilgrim.
The Cave of Silken Web Seven seductive Spiders lie in wait for our faithful heroes in the third installment of the Shaw Brothers adaptation of Journey to the West.
The Black Falcon Two women and a man have to deal with forgery, fire and poisoned needles when they go up against a notorious gang.
Hex A young couple lived happily in a house but the woman becomes haunted after she accidentally kills her husband.
The Killer Starring Chin Han, Wang Ping and Tsung Hua, this movie revolves around the challenges that beset three sworn brothers and sisters.
The Emperor and the Minister From veteran director Li Han-hsiang comes this fascinating period drama, starring Li Kun as the ingenious Lord Liu, who is much envied by the Emperor.
Crippled Avengers Chang Cheh presents this ultimate depiction of dysfunctional kung fu masters, overcoming their shortcomings to win the day, one corpse at a time.
Rear Entrance This moving tale centers on a childless woman who cares for an emotionally battered girl.
That Fiery Girl Death and destruction are the order of the day after a bandit's daughter learns some painful truths about her past.
The Monkey Goes West This is the first of four related Shaw Brothers film adaptations of the legendary Journey To The West.
The Spiritual Boxer A young man and his sifu earn a living as pseudo-ghost catchers until his sifu is arrested and an honest gal becomes his new companion.
The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy Three women and three men beguile, blackmail, bicker and backstab each other all the way to a shocking surprise ending.
Heroes Two Shaolin loyalists (led by Alexander Fu Sheng and Chen Kuan Tai) go up against a formidable Manchu general and his Tibetan allies.
Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins When a bag of jewels falls from the sky, that's just the start of Ah Niu's misadventures involving a brothel, a disastrous wedding night and the cops!
The Golden Sword After a kidnapped swordsman is surprisingly rescued by the father he had been looking for, he also learns about his mother from him.
Disco Bumpkins This musical production features George Lam in a humorous tale of a man who seeks love and success in a world of TV commercials, along with his two friends.
The Black Butterfly A waitress, who is secretly the outlaw Black Butterfly, steals from the rich and gives to the poor but picking the wrong targets sets the law on her heels.
King Drummer In Shaw Brothers' showcase for the talented Ling Yun, a young drummer hungry for fame sacrifices everything including love, for his art. Will the prize prove worth the cost?
Magnificent Wanderers Share the adventures of patriot Chu Tieh-hsieh and his three comrades, who head out with the aim of 'relieving' Mongolian invaders of their ill-gotten gains.
Hong Kong Nocturne Three sisters (the quietest and most filial of whom is played by Cheng Pei Pei) attempt to sing and dance their way to happiness.
The Champion After years in prison, Lu Hu returns to find his ruthless brother has taken over the family business and imprisoned their sister. Now, Hu and his sister must fight to get their lives back.
Clan of Amazons This action-packed adventure centres on a mysterious masked highwayman who not only steals from the rich but also blinds them!
Lady General Hua Mu Lan A young woman joins the army in place of her old, ailing father and only when she returns home is the truth revealed.
The Avenging Eagle This martial arts drama centres on the Thirteen Eagles Assassination Sect of the infamous Iron Boat Clan. Starring Ti Lung, Fu Sheng.
Gang Master As a young clan member rises to helm the Dragon gang after his foster father's death, an incriminating letter changes everything. Can he fight the tide?
The Brave Archer 3 Kuo Tsing's (Alexander Fu Sheng) adventures continue in Part 3 of this series of film adaptations of 'The Eagle Shooting Heroes'.
My Son A detective's son's attempt to punish a swindler leads to him and his father having their own face-off. Starring Jimmy Wang Yu.
Full Moon Scimitar Screen idol Derek Yee is the ambitious 'Meteor' master who becomes obsessed with sword supremacy and goes on a selfish rampage of violence and sex.
Rose, Be My Love A love rectangle lies at the heart of this romantic drama with an eve of World War II setting. Starring Kwan Shan, Li Ting.
The Gambling Syndicate When a young provincial detective seeks to take down a local gambling syndicate with the help of two convicts, will they succeed?
Boxer Rebellion The Empress Dowager's use of the Boxers to remove the foreign powers from China yields unexpected results. Starring Alexander Fu.
Killers on Wheels While taking a ferry on the way to a vacation, Kwok and his family meet a road thug who puts an ugly spin on their holiday plans.
Intimate Confessions of a Chinese Courtesan This 1972 cult classic stars Lily Ho in her most audacious role as a mysterious courtesan caught in a web of sex and murder with her powerful madam.
Legend of the Bat Director Chor Yuen reunites with novelist, Gu Long, and superstar, Ti Lung, in this exciting sequel to Clans of Intrigue.
Sex, Love and Hate Controversial director Chu Yuan combines stars to create a masterpiece about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women expect of it.
Mercenaries From Hong Kong In Wong Jing's first modern drama spiced up by three great kung fu choreographers, stars Ti Lung, Chen Hui Min, Wang Lung Wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu defy death.
Crazy Shaolin Disciples Kung fu idols Wang Yu, Lo Meng and Loh Lieh star in this comedy set in a Shaolin temple where Hung Hsi-kuan and Fang Shih-yu become disciples.
Long Road to Gallantry Hui Ying-hung stars in this riveting swordswoman epic, as he embarks on a quest to find a missing martial arts manual.
The Mermaid Fans of 'The Little Mermaid' are in for a delightful surprise when they see this spectacular Chinese operatic adaptation, where a carp turns into a fairy.
Cat VS Rat After the emperor's seal is stolen, 'The Rat' and 'The Cat's' squabble for martial arts supremacy is put on hold for a time.
Summer Heat This drama centres on the seductive Judy. A woman with a rich husband, she also has two lovers who happen to be brothers!
Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre This Yuan Dynasty tale tells of the Sacred Fire sect, Wu Tang clan, O Mei's disciples, a sacred book, and the destruction of Shaolin.
The Younger Generation After a young mother and her husband die, one child is sold into prostitution to feed the other four.
The Villains When the younger of two brothers becomes a villain, tragedy lurks when his elder brother makes it his mission to take him down.
The Crimson Palm Featuring the unforgettable song Country Road, Shaw's Huangmei Opera stars Ivy Ling Po and tells the tale of a poor student engaged to a billionaire's daughter.
Heaven and Hell Martial artistic mayhem is added to Dante's 'Inferno' with the bringing together of Alexander Fu, David Chiang and the Five Venoms!
Moods of Love How far would you go for love? Or lust? These are the questions posed in two, sinfully entertaining Sung Dynasty tales that comprise this film.
The New Shaolin Boxers Alexander Fu stars as a young carriage driver who finds love and encounters peril after he rescues a girl from being harassed by a dangerous group.
Killer Clans This abourer and complex adaptation of a popular wuxia novel contains conspiracies, stratagems, and sword fights aplenty.
Life Gamble Legendary director Chang Cheh teams Alexander Fu Sheng and 'Venoms' Lo Meng and Kuo Chue in an exciting tale of a kung fu blacksmith.
The Magic Blade In this wuxia film, two rival swordsmen vie with a power-hungry villain to possess the dangerous 'Peacock Dart'.
Dead End Directed by Chang Cheh and starring Ti Lung in his first main role, this drama depicts how two lovers contend with family opposition and an unjust accusation.
The Sword of Swords After a master passes on his magical weapon to his top student, a jealous rival goes and kidnaps the man's fiance.
Tiger Killer Adapted from the novel Water Margin and starring Ti Lung, this award-winning drama depicts how the courageous Wu Song defeats a tiger, and his bond with Wu Da Lang.
The Brave Archer 2 In this 'Brave Archer' sequel, Kuo Tsing's (Alexander Fu Sheng) love for Huang Yung (Niu Niu) is challenged by Ouyang Fung.
Tales of Larceny Be tickled by the slippery efforts of three pickpockets, so adept at their chosen skill that they even manage to fleece three beauties of their underwear!
Invincible Shaolin Award-winning director Chang Cheh depicts the struggle of the Shaolin monasteries when the Ching Dynasty sets trap to separate and destroy them.
The Comedy of Mismatches Pat Ting Hung, Carrie Ku Mei and Li Hsiang Chun star in this delightful tale of mistaken identities caused by monogrammed handkerchiefs.
Demon of the Lute Go on a courageous quest with Hsiao Feng-ling and her classmate, as they try to capture the lute demon Chin Mo and send him back to the netherworld.
The Delinquent A hothead (Wang Chung) is tempted by the dark side in this coming-of-age tale which centres on c. 1970s lower-class Hong Kong teens.
Table for Six Three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists on dinner together every night, but tensions rises when their girlfriends join the table.
Cesium Fallout Hong Kong's survival is at risk due to a radiation leak. A fire brigade is assigned to stop cesium fallout by entering the radiation zone. Facing this unprecedented disaster, can they save the city?
Little Red Sweet A family running a Chinese dessert shop faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. This heartfelt journey reveals the strength of family bonds, sacrifices, and resilience.
8 Bucks Tycoon When a struggling painter receives a magical wallet that endlessly produces RM8 notes, his life transforms from hardship to luxury. However, is this miracle truly a blessing or a hidden curse?
Dust to Dust A blurred figure in a news clip prompts retired cop Wang Shou Yue to reinvestigate a cold case where the mastermind gets tipped off and escapes. A battle between good and evil has just begun!
Time Still Turns the Pages High school teacher Cheng finds a suicide note, triggering his childhood memories. He strives to prevent the suicide tragedy, while dealing with his wife's divorce request and his father's illness.
Honey Money Phony Deceived by a romantic scam and burdened with a massive debt, Lin partners with con artist Ouyang to reclaim her money. Together, they defy the odds and discover an unexpected love in the process.
Forbidden City Cop A huge hit in the HK, this typical Stephen Chow movie combines history, science fiction, martial arts & comedy elements makes it a fun watch.
Love Punch Caught in an underground fight to pay off debts, talented boxer Jia Yang loses her Olympics dream and quits boxing. A decade later, Coach Li aids her comeback. Can Jia Yang resurrect her boxing dream?
All's Well End's Well Too Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.
My First Of May Former squash champion Teng and his wife are devastated by their daughter's muscular dystrophy. Years later, the faint movement of her pinky finger gives them a small but powerful sign of hope.
Raging Fire Starring Donnie Yen, Nicholas Tse, an inspector discovers that the team of masked thugs who killed his co-workers are led by a former fellow cop who was forced into a life of crime by him.
Inner Senses Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan seeks help from psychiatrist Dr Jim. As she heals, Jim is haunted by the same disturbances when his suppressed memories resurface.
Ready o/r Knot A couple who first meet at a wedding & have been together for five years, question the institution of marriage from opposing viewpoints. Should marriage always be the 'next step.'?
Tristar A young priest striving to save lost souls crosses paths with a prostitute seeking refuge in the church to escape her debts, they get entangled in a CID investigation into a prostitution ring.
Love After Love Marking the 3rd Eileen Chang adaptation directed by Ann Hui, this film is set in pre-WW2 Hong Kong, where a young girl ends up working for her aunt seducing rich & powerful men.
Cliff Walkers Zhang Yi Mou's first spy thriller follows four Communist Party special agents who embark on a secret mission in the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo - only to be sold out by a traitor.
Out of Order A successful lawyer's secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos.
One More Chance Chow Yun-Fat plays the unlucky gambler Chui Sui-Fai, whose ex-girlfriend asks him to take care of their autistic son. He reluctantly agreed and the two slowly begin to build their relationship.
97 Aces Go Places When the reluctant son of a gangster is summoned home to avenge his father's death, he enlists his father's always-drunk bodyguard to help him out.
Once in a Blue Moon Mei Zhen's family appears to get along but harbours secrets - she struggles at work, her brother hides his separation and their mother fears her past will affect them. Can they overcome these hurdles?
LEIO An ex-singer returns to his hometown & takes part in a water drilling contest to save his drought-stricken town, only to discover a fierce and deadly beast lurking underground!
The Kid From The Big Apple This heartwarming box office smash captures how a little Chinese girl, raised in New York, begins to discover her roots when she visits Malaysia.
The Panda Plan: Magical Tribe Superstar Jackie Chan and panda Hu Hu are ambushed by robbers during their journey. In the chaos, they plunge off a cliff and discover a mysterious, isolated tribe hidden from the outside world.
Operation Hadal Deep-sea special forces and the submarine 'Long Jing' join forces to stop an international super-submarine conspiracy, battling through enemy ambushes and treacherous depths in a thrilling showdown.
Back Home Wing, who can see ghosts since young, discovers that the visions that once haunted him have become worse in his home. Caught between the living and dead, Wing must bring the truth to light to be free.
Endgame A remake from the Japanese movie Key of Life, Andy Lau, Xiao Yang and Wan Qian stars in this action comedy about the switched identities of an unsuccessful actor & a professional assassin.
No One Like Me Yang Qian Huan, once a golden boy, sees his glory fade after the birth of Xu Qi An. Yet, rising from his downfall, Yang defiantly forges his own path, refusing to bow to fate.
All U Need is Love When a luxury hotel in Hong Kong suddenly becomes a Coronavirus superspreader, guests & the staff are faced with a 14-day trial they may not survive.
Wild City Hong Kong director Ringo Lam returns after seven years with this action drama in which a cop-turned-bar-owner & his brother are pulled into a gang war.
My Blue Summer Zhi has been secretly in love with high school classmate Nan from the moment they met. They finally become close friends when they entered the same university, but will Zhi ever confess his feelings?
I Still Remember An uplifting sports drama focusing on a property agent who leads an aimless, unfulfilling life & his P.E teacher, as they seek to find purpose in their lives.
Love for All Seasons Womanizer Tiger Hung arrives in Mount Emei to get the cure of his illness. May is the only woman who is capable to do so, but Tiger has to break her heart first before she gains the healing power.
Reunion Dinner When an engaged couple is requested to invite their parents for a CNY client event, the fiance - who is estranged from his mother, fakes a family. However, things spiral out of control.
Fox Hunt Fraudster Dai resurfaces in Paris after seven years on the run. The Chinese Fox Hunt Team is on a cross-border mission to recover stolen assets and uncovers shocking secrets during the manhunt.
An Abandoned Team Uncle Jia is bad tempered and lives alone. He decides to end his life as he feels hopeless but is saved by a stray dog and an animal welfare volunteer, allowing him to rediscover his purpose in life.
The Last Tycoon Framed and forced to leave all he loves, a grocery clerk ultimately grows into one of Shanghai's most powerful mob bosses. Yet, can he leave the past behind?
Honey Money Phony Deceived by a romantic scam and burdened with a massive debt, Lin partners with con artist Ouyang to reclaim her money. Together, they defy the odds and discover an unexpected love in the process.
Lost Love Mei tries to get over her young son's death by becoming a foster parent. Her dedication to the children leads her to neglect her husband. Will the couple be able to salvage their relationship?
Hell Hole The movie features three horror stories in different era, revolving around a pregnant woman, a bullied boy who committed suicide, and some company staff who open a box of used clothes.
WE 12 12 elite members of an underground organization who possess extraordinary skills need to revive their team spirit and reunite to save the world from disaster.
MUMU Mumu connects her deaf father to the outside world, but their peaceful life is disrupted when she must adapt and fit in to the hearing world, while her father is ensnared by a gang to commit crime.
Good Game A desperate internet cafe owner recruits his daughter, a washed-up action star and a failed pro gamer to form a ragtag esports teamall for a HK500k tournament and one last, no-regrets shot.
The Lychee Road A single lychee triggers a Tang Dynasty "Mission Impossible"! Junior official Li races 1,000 miles in three days to satisfy a consort's craving - an epic ride of tension, humour and biting satire!
Red Line A former professional racer falls into despair after causing his brother's death. He meets Dr. Hui & becomes an ambulance driver. Meanwhile, his friends uncover the truth behind his brother's accident.
It's a Wonderful Life Yam Tai Foon, a wealthy man is unhappy with his son's failed marriage and Kwai's dream of being a comic artist. He pins hopes on his daughter, On, but she returns from France with wild Ruberto.
CJ7 When a poor laborer picks up a toy for his son from a dumpster, the events that follow teach them about the true nature of family and things money can't buy.
Wish Comes True Fei meets young talent Wai who suffers from a rare disease, and helps Wai find his lost love. Even when they know the drug treating Wai is ineffective, they choose to embrace hope and love together.
YOLO After years of self-neglect, Le Ying decides to embrace life anew. Meeting a boxing coach sparks her desire for a fresh start. Despite the challenges ahead, she embarks on a transformative journey.
Caught In Time Based on a string of real robberies and murder cases, a detective engages in a mouse-and-cat game with the 'Eagle Gang', a group of sophisticated, well-trained and ruthless robbers.
Over My Dead Body When an unidentified corpse is found at a residential unit, the residents fear that its presence will turn their home into an ill-fated house, leading to a chaotic endeavor to remove the body.
Resurrection In a world without dreams, a monster wanders through a vanishing dreamworld. A woman who can see its hidden visions ventures deep into its dreams to seek the buried truth.
The Brotherhood of Rebel Chai, a triad member, helps his friend Meow flee after Meow's attempt to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, their paths cross when Meow's life is in danger again. Will Chai choose loyalty over duty?
Turns We Take A traffic accident that resulted in a taxi driver being blinded inexplicably connects a group of unrelated people together, including blind masseurs from a massage center, a young man & a couple.
Detective Chinatown 1900 In 1900s San Francisco, the murder of a white woman in Chinatown ignites public outrage. Two Chinese detectives race against time to uncover the true killer amid mounting tension and danger.
The White Storm 3: Heaven or Hell Two undercover cops successfully develop a brotherly bond with a Thai drug lord. When the police busts the syndicate, the drug lord discovers that there is betrayal within his circle of trust...
Chilli Laugh Story Coba turns his mother's chili sauce into a trendy commodity during the pandemic, with the help of the whole family. The business booms online, bringing them unexpected success and unity.
Fly Me to the Moon New Hong Kong immigrants Yuan and her sister face identity crises, poverty and their father's drug addiction. Even as they separate from their father, Yuan finds his traits mirrored in her loved ones.
Life Must Go On When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at risk of closing down due to funding, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match to save it.
Honey Money Phony Deceived by a romantic scam and burdened with a massive debt, Lin partners with con artist Ouyang to reclaim her money. Together, they defy the odds and discover an unexpected love in the process.
Kung Fu Hustle This award-winning film directed, written and starred in by Stephen Chow, depicts the adventure of a wannabe gangster who aspires to join the notorious Axe Gang.
Victim(s) After a ruthless Kuala Lumpur student murders his classmate, the victim's mother and the killer's mother uncover hidden truths about their sons and face very different paths of grief and torment.
Table for Six 2 Bernard and Lung plan to get married when their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for all involved!

The Date/Dude Relax!/Laundry Day/Ghost Boy/La Larva Amor Robin poses as Speedy to sabotage his upcoming date with Starfire.
The Toopee Show Amato and MechaBot are invited to a children's show hosted by squirrel mascot Toopee, but things get weird really fast.
Plane Excited/Ren Faire Clarence is very excited to visit his grandmother when he learns that Chad has never been on a plane. Clarence makes it his mission to help Chad get through a hectic flight.
The Helmet/The Fight Gumball's magic tinfoil helmet threatens to tear the Watterson family apart!
The Amadin/The Burger Gumball joins odd traditions to help Pennys birthday party.
Window Of Opportunity/IrmaS Surprise/A Day In Bed/Karting Bean/Bowled Over Mr Bean invents a mobile window-cleaning device to help the street win a competition.
Bonehead A dog uncovers trouble when he buries a bone in Bugs Bunny's hole.
The Mustache/The Date/The Club/The Wand/The Ape Gumball and Darwin's wish comes true when they suddenly turn into men.
Park Managers Lunch/Eileen Flat Screen Benson must get back safely from his lunch with Gene.
Brian/Nature When The Brain captures the Titans to fuel Project B.R.I.A.N., the Titan's littles buddies are the only heroes who can save them.
Cat's Fancy/Leg Day/Dignity Of Teeth/Croissant/Spice Game Robin decides to be a cat so that Starfire will love him.
Sunken Sub/Flounder Fam/Land World/Bermuda Baby Bears/First Day Of Art School Panda pilots a submarine.
Is That You?/Everything's Jake/The Visitor/The Cooler/The Mountain After a memorial for a fallen ally, Jake starts acting very strange.
Gem Harvest/Three Gems And A Baby Steven works his magic and makes a pumpkin come to life. Lapis and Peridot are disappointed that the newly-living beast doesn't immediately take to them.
Bottom Bump The Teletubbies bottom bounce on The Tubby Bouncy before wiggling their bottoms to a special bottom bump song.
O Dee encourages a friend to say 'o', and we go on an adventure around the sound. We meet an octopus and an orangutan, and see an ostrich in an office!
Fossil Puzzle In the real world, Messy is bored of his dino-jigsaw. In OKIDO, his friends help him piece together a real prehistoric puzzle!
Super Secret Swoptops It's secret agent time when Mojo and Bo think Didi the tractor is up to something fishy. But can the two supersecret spies follow her without being spotted?
Ragdoll Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... he's just entered 'Ragdoll' mode!
Faceytalk Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with Muffin and Socks so they can all draw pictures together. When Muffin won't give Socks a turn, the kids discover what happens when you hog.
The Why Badge All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.
The Mime Badge Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through t
Say Cheese The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.
Night And Day Have you ever wondered what goes on at the Squirrel Club when the sun goes down?
The Jigokudani Monkey Park, Japan The Go Jetters fly to the rescue in Japan, as Glitch gets up to his usual monkey business.
Butterflies Playing 'Butterflies' in the backyard is great fun, until Bluey runs away with Judo leaving Bingo all alone. Now poor Bingo's heartbroken and Bluey needs to make amends.
Piggyback The Heelers take a long riverside walk, but Bingo's legs are tired, and she wants a piggyback. To distract her, mum and dad invent fun games and get her little legs moving again.
The Decider The Heelers and Lucky's family get together to watch the big game, a fun family experiences that gets a little tense.
Cubby Bluey and Bingo build a very special cubby for their stuffed toy Kimjim.
Andy and the Lost Pachycephalosaurus Andy and Jen jump into the magic old museum clock and travel 68 million years back in time for prehistoric adventures on Dino Island. The duo search for a missing baby Pachycephalosaurus called Bumper, who has become separated from his family. Jen looks for him in some nearby caves, while Andy heads to the river.
Cats Bella has fun pretending to be a cat - a Bella-Cat. Together with Lift, she visits Tincy the Spider in the Sing Song Forest, who sings a spider rhyme all about taily-waily animals!
The Soap Opera Badge After breaking the Chickens' TV aerial during the finale of their favourite soap opera, the Squirrels take it upon themselves to recreate the final episode for them. But will their performance impress the grumpy Chickens?
The Mythical Creature Badge The Squirrels find a hidden book about mythical creatures. They learn and discover a wide range of mythical creatures, create their own and find out why the book was hidden in the first place.
The Puzzle Badge The Squirrels are close to finishing a jigsaw puzzle when the Naughty Mice steal their last piece. To get it back, they must take part in a series of puzzles in an underground adventure set by the Puzzle Mouse.
The Pyramids of Giza, Egypt Glitch creates trouble with a little pyramid when he and the Go Jetters visit the Pyramids of Giza in Egypt.
The Eiffel Tower, France The Go Jetters try to fix the Eiffel tower after Grandmaster Glitch breaks it while using it as a TV aerial.
Cleo's First Snow Cleo is shocked to learn snow does not last forever and tries to stop it from melting.
Seacow Snow Trail Sarah and Duck have received some Christmas Presents and are keen to find out who delivered them.
Origami Overload John has a problem with the origami flamingos he has made and needs Sarah and Duck's help.
Can-Bots Stanley is very busy, so he invents three little robots called the Can Bots to help. They begin well but soon start getting out of hand. Stanley has some reprogramming to do.
Noisy Night There's a funny noise around town. It's distracting the children's music practice and keeping everyone else up. Stanley investigates with the help of Myrtle.
I Could Be The Best Dancer In The Whole Entire World From disco dancing frogs to skipping puffins and lions that love ballet, the talking animals discuss the best things about dancing.
It's Time to Go To Work When Mummy sets off for work at the hospital, JoJo wants to know what a job is. To explain, Gran Gran takes JoJo to see their friends, who work in all their different jobs. While they're out, they realise Mummy accidentally took Gran Gran's phone to the hospital with her. Now JoJo has a job - visiting Mummy to fix the mix-up and making sure she gets her phone back!
Driving With only five minutes to play 'Driving', Bluey and Mum race against the clock to buy milk for a grumpy guest and have to escape an angry shopkeeper.
Tina Tired of being told what to do, Bluey and Bingo enlist their giant invisible friend Tina to show Mum and Dad who's boss. Now they can do anything they want, until Mum and Dad rebel.
Whale Watching Bluey promises her customer, Bingo, the best tour ever in a game of Whale Watching, but they need Mum and Dad to join in, and they are too tired to play after a late night.
The Eating Badge The Squirrels are having a picnic and notice that the chickens eat differently than they do. Duggee has his eating badge and can explain all the different ways animals eat. Some animals eat slowly like cows, who eat all day long. But others eat quickly like frogs. Some, like goats, are always eating, while tortoises can go a whole year without food. Some animals eat food that is very high up, like
The Dream Badge The Squirrels are at the Clubhouse playing, but they can't stop thinking about the dreams they had last night. Luckily, Duggee has his dream badge and can help the Squirrels work out what they mean. As the Squirrels think about dreams, all the different dreams of the Clubhouse friends become weirder and more wonderful. We even get to see Duggee's dream!
Mystery Seeds When Duggee finds some seeds it's time for some gardening!
The Grand Canyon, USA Kyan is completing his 'GoJet Academy' high-wire training, above the Grand Canyon, but he's not the only wire-walker out there...
Parsnip Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Parsnip performing a jaw dropping escape that will leave even Houdini speechless.
Spinach Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the exceptional painter, Spinach, creating Kiwi's portrait, if Kiwi can keep still.
How to be a Supertato Supertato shows the Grape Kids a Supertato training film, but Evil Pea sneaks in to take over Tato Tower. The Grape Kids use the rug launcher to eject Evil Pea out of the tower.
The Throne Thief Supertato, Carrot, Broccoli and Chilli are playing when, suddenly, they hear a scream and discover an upset Evil Pea in her freezer. Her throne has been stolen! Who would do such a thing?
Washing Po eats Tubby Custard and gets a messy bib. Po washes the bib clean and hangs it out to dry before eating more Tubby Custard with Tinky Winky, Dipsy and LaaLaa.
P Dee encourages a friend to say 'p', and we go on an adventure around the sound. We eat some popcorn and pizza, and even have a pyjama party!
Funny Bones Lofty has a broken finger, so Mustard goes in search of help. Messy and friends save the day and discover that bones are amazing.
Ludwig The Lady Jackson's big, blue chicken-thing, Ludwig, is going to lay an egg. And it's up to Mojo and Bo to carry the big bird across dangerous roads to Preston's egg-hatching shed!
Fairy Tale Dad tells Bluey and Bingo a real-life fairy tale about growing up in a wild place called the '80s, about a boy who was cursed when he was mean to his little brother.
Ragdoll Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... he's just entered 'Ragdoll' mode!
The Sibling Badge It's news time at the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower and Roly, after thinking hard if he's got any news at all, remembers he's getting a new brother or sister. The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.
The Why Badge All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.
Eugene's Animal Chorus Eugene gives an unexpected performance with help from some talented animals! Mooo!
Say Cheese The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.
The Nazca Lines, Peru The Go Jetters race to protect ancient artwork in Peru, when Glitch erases the Nazca Lines.
Yoga Ball Bingo loves playing with Dad, but sometimes he forgets Bingo is smaller than her sister. Mum teaches Bingo how to use her big girl bark to keep the fun within her limits.
The Show When Bingo drops Mum's breakfast-in-bed on the floor, she's convinced she's ruined her big day. But Bluey helps make amends by putting on a play of how Mum and Dad first met.
Cubby Bluey and Bingo build a very special cubby for their stuffed toy Kimjim.
Exercise Dad thinks he needs to do some exercise, but Bingo pretends to be Boss Bluey's new employee in the middle of Dad's backyard workout.
Andy and the Quetzalcoatlus Egg When a Quetzalcoatlus egg Jen has been watching is knocked out of its nest, Andy sets out on an epic adventure across Dino Island to retrieve and reunite it with its family.
Sticks Bella and Lift play with a stick that makes the perfect magic wand. They visit Patch, who has a tasty recipe - sticky stick critters!
The Board Game Badge It is a rainy day in the clubhouse which means it's a perfect day for a board game. Duggee introduces the Squirrels to one of his favourite games, but it might be just a little bit too complex for them.

Funny Bones Lofty has a broken finger, so Mustard goes in search of help. Messy and friends save the day and discover that bones are amazing.
Ludwig The Lady Jackson's big, blue chicken-thing, Ludwig, is going to lay an egg. And it's up to Mojo and Bo to carry the big bird across dangerous roads to Preston's egg-hatching shed!
Fairy Tale Dad tells Bluey and Bingo a real-life fairy tale about growing up in a wild place called the '80s, about a boy who was cursed when he was mean to his little brother.
Ragdoll Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... he's just entered 'Ragdoll' mode!
The Sibling Badge It's news time at the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower and Roly, after thinking hard if he's got any news at all, remembers he's getting a new brother or sister. The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.
The Why Badge All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.
Eugene's Animal Chorus Eugene gives an unexpected performance with help from some talented animals! Mooo!
Say Cheese The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.
The Nazca Lines, Peru The Go Jetters race to protect ancient artwork in Peru, when Glitch erases the Nazca Lines.
Yoga Ball Bingo loves playing with Dad, but sometimes he forgets Bingo is smaller than her sister. Mum teaches Bingo how to use her big girl bark to keep the fun within her limits.
The Show When Bingo drops Mum's breakfast-in-bed on the floor, she's convinced she's ruined her big day. But Bluey helps make amends by putting on a play of how Mum and Dad first met.
Cubby Bluey and Bingo build a very special cubby for their stuffed toy Kimjim.
Exercise Dad thinks he needs to do some exercise, but Bingo pretends to be Boss Bluey's new employee in the middle of Dad's backyard workout.
Andy and the Quetzalcoatlus Egg When a Quetzalcoatlus egg Jen has been watching is knocked out of its nest, Andy sets out on an epic adventure across Dino Island to retrieve and reunite it with its family.
Sticks Bella and Lift play with a stick that makes the perfect magic wand. They visit Patch, who has a tasty recipe - sticky stick critters!
The Board Game Badge It is a rainy day in the clubhouse which means it's a perfect day for a board game. Duggee introduces the Squirrels to one of his favourite games, but it might be just a little bit too complex for them.
The Soap Opera Badge After breaking the Chickens' TV aerial during the finale of their favourite soap opera, the Squirrels take it upon themselves to recreate the final episode for them. But will their performance impress the grumpy Chickens?
The Mythical Creature Badge The Squirrels find a hidden book about mythical creatures. They learn and discover a wide range of mythical creatures, create their own and find out why the book was hidden in the first place.
Stonehenge, England The Go Jetters set out to stop Glitch playing dominoes with the ancient stones of Stonehenge.
The Pyramids of Giza, Egypt Glitch creates trouble with a little pyramid when he and the Go Jetters visit the Pyramids of Giza in Egypt.
Thomas' Animal Friends Thomas is asked to dress up as a monkey for a special event at the Animal Park, but all the other engines laugh at him. Luckily, Rebecca is on hand to offer some useful advice.
Origami Overload John has a problem with the origami flamingos he has made and needs Sarah and Duck's help.
Shallot Circus The Shallots have discovered acrobatics and are inspired by the Ribbon Sisters to put on a show.
Sophie Can Do Stanley asks Sophie to help out with a few of his jobs whilst she waits for her dino costume to dry. The pair go about town fixing everyone's problems in fun and imaginative ways.
Can-Bots Stanley is very busy, so he invents three little robots called the Can Bots to help. They begin well but soon start getting out of hand. Stanley has some reprogramming to do.
I Always Wanted to be a Crab The talking animals talk about all the things they love about the ocean.
It's Time to Play in the Snow JoJo, Gran Gran, Ezra and Jaxon are all set for a day of sledging in the snow, but when the sledge breaks, Gran Gran comes up with a plan so that they all can keep having fun in the snow!
Tina Tired of being told what to do, Bluey and Bingo enlist their giant invisible friend Tina to show Mum and Dad who's boss. Now they can do anything they want, until Mum and Dad rebel.
Whale Watching Bluey promises her customer, Bingo, the best tour ever in a game of Whale Watching, but they need Mum and Dad to join in, and they are too tired to play after a late night.
Family Meeting When Dad's accused of 'fluffing' in Bluey's face as he climbed out of bed, he's put on trial with Mum as the judge, and Bluey and Bingo as witnesses. Bluey might also have to explain what she was doing there.
The Delivery Badge Chipmunk is cycling one day delivering his packages when he hits a rock and his trike falls apart! He has so many packages to deliver - what is he going to do now? Duggee offers to repair Delivery Chipmunk's trike, but that will take too long. The packages need to be delivered right away or else! Duggee also has a delivery badge and he will try to deliver all of Chipmunk's packages with the help o
The Eating Badge The Squirrels are having a picnic and notice that the chickens eat differently than they do. Duggee has his eating badge and can explain all the different ways animals eat. Some animals eat slowly like cows, who eat all day long. But others eat quickly like frogs. Some, like goats, are always eating, while tortoises can go a whole year without food. Some animals eat food that is very high up, like
Splash Dash Duggie chooses a key and his blue digger to dig up a big bone. The chipmunk makes a delivery to the squirrels.
Easter Island, Chile Grandmaster Glitch is on holiday to the remote Easter Island to avoid crowds, but when he arrives he finds droves of tourists everywhere!
Lychee Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's love and peace symbol, Lychee, performing his song - "All You Need is Lychee!"
Parsnip Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Parsnip performing a jaw dropping escape that will leave even Houdini speechless.
The Throne Thief Supertato, Carrot, Broccoli and Chilli are playing when, suddenly, they hear a scream and discover an upset Evil Pea in her freezer. Her throne has been stolen! Who would do such a thing?
Broccoli Alone Supertato is out chasing a milkshake robot and leaves Broccoli in charge of Tato Tower. Evil Pea tries to take over the tower, but Broccoli puts on a great defence.
Flamenco The Teletubbies are flamenco dancing! Tinky Winky, Dispy, LaaLaa and Po are surprisingly good.
Q Dee encourages a friend to say 'qu', and we go on an adventure around the sound. We see question marks, a quilt and a queen, and even meet a quail quacking quietly!
Messy Antics During Mayor Oki's birthday picnic, Messy and friends get in trouble with Zam's shrinkasizer! Time to solve these OKIDO antics!
Hide and Seek Everyone wants to win Swoppiton's hide-and-seek tournament. But Mojo and Bo accidentally break the prize. They need to put it back together without the seeker spotting them!
Musical Statues At the end of a long day, Bluey and her family are out of sync and out of sorts, so Mum gets everyone to play musical statues.
Fairy Tale Dad tells Bluey and Bingo a real-life fairy tale about growing up in a wild place called the '80s, about a boy who was cursed when he was mean to his little brother.
The Monster Badge The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so... with startling results. The creature bursts into tears! The creature, whose name is Plinky, tells them her whole family are monsters, and that's what she's supposed to be, but she just cannot get the hang of it. The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky

Bat and Ball Madame Gazelle teaches the children how to play Bat and Ball. She teaches them so well that they win the game!

Present Danger / Stressed for the Part Dressed as David Steele, Lincoln is on the hunt for his stolen birthday present before it's destroyed. // After landing a role in a Dairyland production, Luan must hide this news from Mrs. Bernardo, who she beat out.

Unidentified Flailing Octopus Squidward sets out to prove that aliens aren't real...until he has a close encounter of his own.
Scaredy Pat After learning what stage fright is, Patrick fears his own audience.
Mass Gramp-nosis Patrick hypnotizes everyone in Bikini Bottom into becoming GrandPats.
There Goes the Neighborhood Patrick and Squidina go on location to interview their neighbors.
Dance Off / The show must go on Jade's a great dancer which results in her facing Mr Best for dance off in person. // Mica and Jade put on a play to win their school a prize, but forget a key prop so the Marsups step in to help.
Camped! When Dad discovers that his childhood camp is closing, he decides to take the family for one final visit. // They soon uncover a map that could lead to a treasure big enough to save it and prove the existence of an old camp legend.
Dad Reputation / Dream a Lily Dream While playing in her Dad's new band, Luna is worried about her reputation if her friends see her perform. // Lisa discovers the only way to stop Lily's nightmares is to go inside her dreams and fight them herself.
House of Lies After witnessing an excess of lying in the family, Lisa invents lie-detecting glasses to try and curb the fibs.
Unwelcome to the Jungle Sonic finds himself in a strange jungle world with even stranger tree-dwelling versions of his friends, whom he must protect from a "monster" below. Sonic soon learns not everything is as it seems in the depths of the mysterious Boscage Maze!
From Dust Till Dawn Chloe is struggling with her leadership skills, but when a villain attacks her school field trip, Max and Phoebe have to put Chloe in charge while they try to take down the villain and defuse his dangerous astronomical weapon.
Substitute Teacher When a suspicious new student shows up at school, Charlotte and Henry think he may be up to something. Captain Man goes undercover as a substitute teacher to learn more.
iNevel Carly, Sam, and Freddie want their web show to be reviewed by 'Nevelocity', a really popular website that reviews websites and webcasts. When Carly goes to meet Nevel, she finds out he is an annoying boy who wants to date her.
The Birthweek Song Tori struggles to find the perfect birthday gift for Trina, then decides to write her sister a song as a present. An ungrateful Trina turns the song into cash by selling it, enraging Tori.
Hater / Video Pinky is determined to the sway the opinion of an online Sackenhack hater. // After creating an "almost perfect" video short with Babs and JJ, Pinky is determined to make it "all the way perfect".
Ship Wreckers / Writer's Retreat Leni and Luna accidentally wreck Gramps boat when their small viewing party gets out of control. // Lucy struggles to come with ideas when she's given the opportunity to write an original story for the Royal Wood's Gazette.
Gags To Riches / Sole Searching After Luan pranks Grouse with a fake lottery ticket, she has to deal with the consequences of his massive shopping spree. // Lynn desperately searches for a popular brand of basketball shoes after she narrowly misses out on buying a pair.
J-LAD / Big Honey LAD has a sleepover and in an effort to join in, Jack ends up making a promise that turns their night upside down. // When Will's parents visit Canyon Valley, news of the sale of their bee farm sends the family into a big, honey-inheritance spiral.
Scaredy Pat After learning what stage fright is, Patrick fears his own audience.
Cart of Darkness Squidina leads Patrick on a grocery shopping mission.
Little Yellow Book / Bumper to Bumper Squidward finds SpongeBob's diary, and starts reading it out loud in the Krusty Krab. // SpongeBob once again fails his driving test, forcing Mrs. Puff to think outside the box--and off the road.
Hater / Video Pinky is determined to the sway the opinion of an online Sackenhack hater. // After creating an "almost perfect" video short with Babs and JJ, Pinky is determined to make it "all the way perfect".
Washed Up The Louds rent a boat for a relaxing day trip on the lake, but the family ends up marooned on a desert island.
The Butterfly Effect / The Green House After spilling an experiment of Lisa's, Lincoln sets off a chain reaction that unravels the household. // In an effort to be more energy-efficient Lincoln rallies his family to stop using so much electricity.
No Way Out Dread's obsession with recapturing his shard overrules all reason. Rusty Rose agrees the shard is too powerful for any one person, including Sonic. Caught between captain and crew, Sonic fights for his life.
Jailbreak! / Evil Spatula An imprisoned Plankton teams up with his fellow inmates to break out of jail and steal the Krabby Patty secret formula. // SpongeBob replaces his broken spatula with one from Plankton, which may or may not have magical powers.
Scaredy Pat After learning what stage fright is, Patrick fears his own audience.
Cart of Darkness Squidina leads Patrick on a grocery shopping mission.

Flower Power Stan lures the Marsupilamis with the scent from his 100 year orchid, and manages to catch all three.

入住阿拉斯加第6季:7 入住阿拉斯加第6季:北極探險.太太莫莉莎想要靠近人群的現代化房屋，先生班吉偏愛與世隔絕的鄉村風木造房，在預算房屋格局通勤便利度的限制下，他們能否達成共識，買下雙方都喜歡的房子？
倉儲挖寶王第3季:11 倉儲挖寶王第3季:邊車驚喜.維州阿林頓跟美國首府華盛頓住了許多政府與軍事機關人員，這裡的倉庫裡，有從戰時紀念品到古董戰役收藏品等物品，正是湯和艾倫喜歡的東西
倉儲挖寶王第3季:12 倉儲挖寶王第3季:大賺一筆.帕沙第納的倉庫拍賣競爭相當激烈艾倫和湯這天要參加一場盛大的貨櫃拍賣會，由於貨櫃的內容物都為了長途運送而緊密包裝，要找到值錢品會很困難
瑞典邊境護衛隊第2季:2 瑞典邊境護衛隊第2季:第2集.機場海關查獲一名從非歐盟地區入境的旅客攜帶大量香菸水煙菸草跟媽媽味料理
生活科技大解密第16季:8 生活科技大解密第16季:打樁機板球棒和摺扇.本集介紹打樁機板球棒和摺扇打樁機齒輪箱內有六個偏心齒輪板球棒的材料是白柳製作摺扇時，分別以木材削出扇柄和扇骨，黏合後貼上扇面彩繪
美食大揭密2.0第3季:2 美食大揭密2.0第3季:地方傳奇.艾方索瑞貝羅介紹各地經典美食
倉儲挖寶王第5季:2 倉儲挖寶王第5季:特技斜坡.艾倫和湯到商業區去競標有12間倉庫的拍賣會，遇到兩件不湊巧的事，一是以前的助理凱若琳和她爸爸提姆也來和他們競爭，二是12間只剩3間要拍賣
珍品拍賣王第3季:9 珍品拍賣王第3季:喬登機車.本集珍品拍賣王要拍賣的物品有古董燭臺形電話兩幅黎洛伊尼曼的名畫作以及重頭戲喬登機車古董電話是強恩到古董收藏家的家中物色到的，約為1920年代出廠的早期電話，而賣家已改良過電線，因此還具有通話功能黎洛伊尼曼為當代重要的運動賽事畫家，本集中拍賣的兩幅畫雖然是複製品，但上頭皆有畫家與畫中主角喬奈米斯與麥可喬丹的親筆簽名，因此價值三級跳壓軸是喬丹機車，為麥可喬丹摩托車隊改裝的機車，除了改裝配備以外還多了飛人喬丹的彩繪標誌，堪稱市面上速度最快的機車賣家幾年前參加車商主辦的饒舌比賽而贏得這輛獨一無二的機車，如今浪子已成家了，因此決定為愛車找新家
邵帝的夢幻車工坊第2季:6 邵帝的夢幻車工坊第2季:震撼教育.一輛1978年蒙地卡羅要改裝成電影震撼教育中的那輛車；邵帝親臨當地高中指導汽修學程的學生
舊貨獵人第17季:15 舊貨獵人第17季:第15集.本週，德魯參觀了巨大的倉庫，裡面堆滿物品，甚至屋外還有12個貨櫃等著德魯去一探究竟
舊貨獵人修復篇第3季:2 舊貨獵人修復篇第3季:名貴金桌.本集要修復喬治時代的名貴金桌19世紀的打鼓熊自動玩偶，以及中世紀的休閒椅
求生1加1第6季:10 求生1加1第6季:巴西大作戰.曾在原始生活40天合作的退伍軍人EJ史奈德與野外求生專家傑夫少區，來到巴西加拉寶地區在40度高溫下走過炙熱的大草原求生
原始生活-求生界的世界大戰 原始生活-求生界的世界大戰.來自世界各地的參賽者，將為了國家榮耀與20萬美元獎金展開對決參賽者是來自澳洲巴西墨西哥和美國的七組頂尖搭檔
原始生活21天第9季:6 原始生活21天第9季:護理師與銀行家.本集原始生活為觀眾挑戰賽14天版本，節目忠實觀眾麥莉與約翰分別是加護病房護理師與銀行業兩人組合能否順利待滿14天呢？

玩命關頭:15 艾可與何方小姐救出了西斯可佛士迪和蓋瑞但拉斐拉已經控制了東尼和萊拉的心靈，要他們倆為她參加貧民窟賽車，好讓她在群眾中釋放心靈控制化合物！
功夫熊貓-神龍騎士:34 阿波一行人趕回遠古城，布雷德刻意不告訴露辛妲真正的任務，騎士追著阿波一行人到遠古城，德雷克帶了十字弓，想使用武力
功夫熊貓-神龍騎士:35 薇露卡從阿波一行人手中奪走所有武器，並開始召喚遠古大軍
功夫熊貓-神龍騎士:36 艾爾菲利用天上武器讓盤古大陸重新合而為一，他打算以鐵腕作風統治這塊大陸急著想讓他改變心意的布雷德陪他去出任務
巨怪獵人:46 兩個世界的未來都岌岌可危之際，大夥得趕緊找出梅林的墓穴和亞法隆手杖，以免根瑪捷足先登
巨怪獵人:47 一名隱匿已久的盟友現身，告訴吉姆和他的朋友斷頭橋大戰到底發生了什麼事根瑪喚醒莫爾加娜，安格洛則圖謀報復

洪堡涼流:1 在智利托雷斯德爾潘恩，雪山融水注入指狀峽灣，延伸至海洋並匯入洋流，降低海水鹽度河口濕地孕育眾多涉禽，而無數海灣與港口則吸引稀有的海豚與虎鯨
洪堡涼流:2 洪堡洋流雖比多數洋流緩慢，卻是世界上最具活力的洋流之一，因其行經距離極長深海海溝的湧升流將養分帶至海面，使浮游植物大量繁盛，奠定複雜海洋食物鏈的基礎

下課花路米-壯遊闖天下 在沒有爸媽的陪伴下，脫離舒適圈，在有限的經費下，學習自己規劃行程，深度探索神秘陌生的異國文化，挑戰自我極限，用心去感受這趟旅程帶來的可貴經驗，完成一趟不可思議的奇妙旅程...

真珠美人魚:71 七海露亞北太平洋粉紅珍珠的人魚公主，為尋回失落的珍珠與守護海洋世界，而化身人類來到陸地她與其他六位來自不同海域的人魚公主相遇，透過歌聲化為偶像歌手美人魚公主，共同對抗邪惡勢力，並揭開海斗隱藏的重大秘密透過融合魔法音樂與少女心，守護愛與友情，持續充滿勇氣友情與自我成長的動人旅程
神木島:124 這個美麗的世界正因生態變異而面臨危機，為了找到回家的路，他必須與當地的夥伴們組隊，踏上尋找傳說中神木之心的遠征，在這段旅程中，他必須學會誠實勇敢與合作，才能真正成長，並拯救這個接納他的新家園
哈士奇:124 大哈，一隻看似脫線的哈士奇，在妻子過世後獨自撫養兒子小哈他努力想成為完美的父親，卻總是把家事搞得一團糟，讓早熟的兒子對他既無奈又失望然而，大哈有個不為人知的秘密：他是活躍於擂台的傳奇蒙面摔角手月影
汪汪隊立大功:243 精通科技的10歲男孩Ryder在拯救了6條小狗之後，將他們訓練成了一組本領高強的狗狗巡邏隊每個小狗都性格鮮明，也各有特長斑點狗Marshall擅長火中急救；斗牛犬Rubble精通工程機械；牧羊犬Chase是個超級特工；混血兒Rocky是個維修能手；拉布拉多犬Zuma最熟悉水中救援；而可卡頗犬Skye掌握著各種航空技術擁有這麼多解決問題的能力，在加上Ryder提供的炫酷裝備支持，不管遇到多麼困難和危險的救援任務，他們還總是忘不了相互玩鬧，制作輕松的氣氛，而每次幽默樂觀的狗狗能總能順利完成任務

寶可夢 鑽石&珍珠:17 以寶可夢大師為目標繼續旅行的主角小智和搭檔皮卡丘來到了新的冒險舞台神奧地區隨後，他們與目標成為頂級協調訓練家的小光和她的波加曼邂逅，一同踏上旅程各種各樣的邂逅，了解同伴的重要，在戰鬥中洋溢熾熱的友情，不斷成長
袋鼠海灘救援隊:15 故事發生在陽光燦爛的袋鼠海灘，四位活力十足的小夥伴勇敢熱血總是衝第一的小龐，聰明可靠擅長冷靜判斷的潔瑪，機靈古怪點子最多的莉茲，以及溫柔細心總是照顧大家的奈奈，在資深救生員的帶領下接受訓練，學習成為守護海灘的救生小隊
瑪莎與熊:36 瑪莎是個活力四射愛笑好動的小女孩，某一天瑪莎在森林裡不小心闖進熊的家，熊從馬戲團裡退休了，本來想要好好享受安靜的時光，但是淘氣的瑪莎就是愛纏著熊，熊一時心軟接納了瑪莎，於是個性完全不同的瑪莎與熊著逐漸變成最好的朋友， 活潑的瑪莎總是坐不住，大小事都喜歡參一腳，因為瑪莎的出現，熊的生活也變得多采多姿

騎士出任務 (2010) 當一對亡命鴛鴦那段光鮮亮麗卻時而致命的冒險,演變成充滿背叛死裡逃生虛假身分以及令人頭昏眼花的愛情糾葛迷宮時,他們才終於意識到,此時此刻唯一能指望的,就只有彼此了

六人行第7季:18 菲比（莉莎庫卓 Lisa Kudrow 飾）和瑞秋（詹妮弗安妮斯頓 Jennifer Aniston 飾）的公寓已經修復完畢，菲比搬回了公寓，瑞秋繼續和喬伊（馬特理勃蘭 Matt LeBlanc 飾）住在一起喬伊在Days of Our Lives劇組裡得到了一個角色就在錢德勒（馬修派瑞 Matthew Perry 飾）和摩妮卡（柯特妮考克斯 Courteney Cox 飾）的婚禮前一夜，錢德勒突然臨陣畏縮，逃走躲了起來他走了之後，菲比在衛生間找了一支顯示有孕的驗孕棒，從而斷定摩妮卡有了身孕菲比和羅斯（大衛史威默 David Schwimmer 飾）在辦公室找到了躲藏錢德勒並說服他回來，回來後他聽到了菲比與瑞秋的竊竊私語摩妮卡懷孕了！最後錢德勒和摩妮卡順利完婚，但摩妮卡卻說自己並沒有懷孕時那麼，懷孕的人難道是瑞秋嗎？

宅男行不行第8季:18 在上一季的結尾，萊納德和佩妮宣佈訂婚，他們和謝爾頓商量讓他搬出公寓，女友艾米建議謝爾頓與她同居，這把謝爾頓嚇壞了與此同時，他們最愛的漫畫店慘遭火災謝爾頓一時間難以接受生活中的種種變故，負氣出走一個多月過去了，謝爾頓會在這場跨越美國大陸的旅程中遭遇什麼？在新的一季中，其他幾位主角的生活也有新變化佩妮放棄了演藝事業，正式踏入了藥品推銷之路，她與伯納黛特將會成為同事霍華德最煩惱的事是，自己的媽媽和漫畫店老闆斯圖爾特住在一起單身漢拉傑什何時才能找到女朋友？

宅男行不行第8季:19 在上一季的結尾，萊納德和佩妮宣佈訂婚，他們和謝爾頓商量讓他搬出公寓，女友艾米建議謝爾頓與她同居，這把謝爾頓嚇壞了與此同時，他們最愛的漫畫店慘遭火災謝爾頓一時間難以接受生活中的種種變故，負氣出走一個多月過去了，謝爾頓會在這場跨越美國大陸的旅程中遭遇什麼？在新的一季中，其他幾位主角的生活也有新變化佩妮放棄了演藝事業，正式踏入了藥品推銷之路，她與伯納黛特將會成為同事霍華德最煩惱的事是，自己的媽媽和漫畫店老闆斯圖爾特住在一起單身漢拉傑什何時才能找到女朋友？
六人行第7季:22 菲比（莉莎庫卓 Lisa Kudrow 飾）和瑞秋（詹妮弗安妮斯頓 Jennifer Aniston 飾）的公寓已經修復完畢，菲比搬回了公寓，瑞秋繼續和喬伊（馬特理勃蘭 Matt LeBlanc 飾）住在一起喬伊在Days of Our Lives劇組裡得到了一個角色就在錢德勒（馬修派瑞 Matthew Perry 飾）和摩妮卡（柯特妮考克斯 Courteney Cox 飾）的婚禮前一夜，錢德勒突然臨陣畏縮，逃走躲了起來他走了之後，菲比在衛生間找了一支顯示有孕的驗孕棒，從而斷定摩妮卡有了身孕菲比和羅斯（大衛史威默 David Schwimmer 飾）在辦公室找到了躲藏錢德勒並說服他回來，回來後他聽到了菲比與瑞秋的竊竊私語摩妮卡懷孕了！最後錢德勒和摩妮卡順利完婚，但摩妮卡卻說自己並沒有懷孕時那麼，懷孕的人難道是瑞秋嗎？
倉庫獵手第3季:11 新手Scott and Chrissy被迫使以前所未有的方式燒錢然後，一套托盤促使競爭升溫，迫使每個人都為完成而戰後來，這次競標了一個神秘的項目當塵埃落定的時候，兩位幸運倉庫獵人揭開了迄今為止最具爆炸性的寶藏
好友互整第8季:11 節目的四位主角是從小一起長大的死黨，他們的任務是輪番被整，他們從小就愛拿最令人難堪不舒服的挑戰來嗆對方
泰坦第1季:9 泰坦故事講述自黑暗崛起的羅賓迪克葛雷森成為一支少年團隊的領導者，招募一群即將成為超級英雄的少年，包括星火（Starfire）烏鴉/酷姬（Raven）戰鷹（Hawk）與白鴿（Dove）等知名 DC 超級英雄將加入這支無畏的團隊
水深火熱 故事背景設定於一座孤立的水下設施，講述了一組科學家及其對灰鯖鯊的研究，以幫助對抗阿茲海默症當多條基因工程鯊魚橫衝直撞並淹沒設施時，情況陷入混亂
電話情殺案 托尼溫戴斯（雷米倫）是英格蘭的職業網球運動員，他娶了富有的交際花瑪格特（格蕾絲凱利），瑪格特曾與美國犯罪小說作家馬克哈利迪（羅伯特卡明斯）有一段風流韻事因瑪格特抱怨托尼日程繁忙，托尼於是選擇退役他秘密發現了她的風流韻事，並決定殺害她，既要報復她，又要確保得到她的遺產

天倫夢覺 故事背景為第一次世界大戰前的加州，詹姆斯狄恩在片中飾演叛逆而令人難以捉摸的卡爾崔斯克（詹姆斯狄恩飾），他和哥哥亞倫愛上了同一位美麗的女子（茱莉哈里斯飾），兩兄弟除了是情場上的敵人，卡爾更得付出極大的努力，以期在父親亞當的面前能勝過哥哥，然而他卻不斷遭遇挫折；另一方面，卡爾執意找出埋藏已久的家族祕密，更為這個家帶來了前所未有的衝擊

六人行第7季:23 菲比（莉莎庫卓 Lisa Kudrow 飾）和瑞秋（詹妮弗安妮斯頓 Jennifer Aniston 飾）的公寓已經修復完畢，菲比搬回了公寓，瑞秋繼續和喬伊（馬特理勃蘭 Matt LeBlanc 飾）住在一起喬伊在Days of Our Lives劇組裡得到了一個角色就在錢德勒（馬修派瑞 Matthew Perry 飾）和摩妮卡（柯特妮考克斯 Courteney Cox 飾）的婚禮前一夜，錢德勒突然臨陣畏縮，逃走躲了起來他走了之後，菲比在衛生間找了一支顯示有孕的驗孕棒，從而斷定摩妮卡有了身孕菲比和羅斯（大衛史威默 David Schwimmer 飾）在辦公室找到了躲藏錢德勒並說服他回來，回來後他聽到了菲比與瑞秋的竊竊私語摩妮卡懷孕了！最後錢德勒和摩妮卡順利完婚，但摩妮卡卻說自己並沒有懷孕時那麼，懷孕的人難道是瑞秋嗎？

宅男行不行第8季:21 在上一季的結尾，萊納德和佩妮宣佈訂婚，他們和謝爾頓商量讓他搬出公寓，女友艾米建議謝爾頓與她同居，這把謝爾頓嚇壞了與此同時，他們最愛的漫畫店慘遭火災謝爾頓一時間難以接受生活中的種種變故，負氣出走一個多月過去了，謝爾頓會在這場跨越美國大陸的旅程中遭遇什麼？在新的一季中，其他幾位主角的生活也有新變化佩妮放棄了演藝事業，正式踏入了藥品推銷之路，她與伯納黛特將會成為同事霍華德最煩惱的事是，自己的媽媽和漫畫店老闆斯圖爾特住在一起單身漢拉傑什何時才能找到女朋友？
六人行第7季:24 菲比（莉莎庫卓 Lisa Kudrow 飾）和瑞秋（詹妮弗安妮斯頓 Jennifer Aniston 飾）的公寓已經修復完畢，菲比搬回了公寓，瑞秋繼續和喬伊（馬特理勃蘭 Matt LeBlanc 飾）住在一起喬伊在Days of Our Lives劇組裡得到了一個角色就在錢德勒（馬修派瑞 Matthew Perry 飾）和摩妮卡（柯特妮考克斯 Courteney Cox 飾）的婚禮前一夜，錢德勒突然臨陣畏縮，逃走躲了起來他走了之後，菲比在衛生間找了一支顯示有孕的驗孕棒，從而斷定摩妮卡有了身孕菲比和羅斯（大衛史威默 David Schwimmer 飾）在辦公室找到了躲藏錢德勒並說服他回來，回來後他聽到了菲比與瑞秋的竊竊私語摩妮卡懷孕了！最後錢德勒和摩妮卡順利完婚，但摩妮卡卻說自己並沒有懷孕時那麼，懷孕的人難道是瑞秋嗎？

型男闖世界:1 誰說型男只能下廚房?! 菜刀換山刀 披荊斬棘挺進叢林 尋找傳說中的勇猛秘方,即使前方的路途危機重重也要勇敢闖.看我怎麼躲過從暗處突襲的血盆大口 怎麼會誤闖蛇蠍美人窩,如何要在異地他鄉挑戰自己完成任務,大千世界無奇不有,一起看牛群為何發瘋似地狂奔 驚魂斷頭就藏在你最意想不到的地方,你相信有人天天吃白磚 還有人一生都離不開了沙嗎,型男闖世界 帶你大開眼界!!
王子的移動城堡 III:9 延續前二季的精神，再度向觀眾推薦經典露營車旅行路線，而除了露營車外，將呈現各國不同的旅遊方式，含行程中的特色飯店餐廳民宿甚至市場文化等，以體驗生活融入在地為構想這一季將邀請懂料理的嘉賓為錦榮打理他的伙食，這是一個隨行廚師的概念，也是與前二季最大的不同，明星真人秀主題旅行體驗在地生活等元素的旅遊節目
33廚房:31 林美秀私房菜大公開啦！讓各位在家也能吃得到海鮮餐廳的五星級料理！醬燒風味的獨門訣竅，讓專業師傅告訴你！念念不忘的傳統好滋味讓人口齒留香，三位師傅精湛的廚藝PK賽究竟誰會成為今天的阿尼吉？！所有美味好吃的料理都在林美秀的３３廚房告訴你！
融融歷險記:30 我是Ben！Youtube頻道融融歷險記 Bens Adventure的創辦人 立志前往那些沒有人要去的地方 走過五大洲75餘國，喜歡拍影片更愛與當地人交流，因為這才是旅行真正的意義 旅行的意義是什麼？ 旅行的意義，看不同的風景，認識不同的人，領略不同的美好，讓你覺得世界那麼大 人生有很多可能，讓你不再局限於一方天地，讓你看得更豁達更寬容 我想，是時候出發了

王子的移動城堡 III:10 延續前二季的精神，再度向觀眾推薦經典露營車旅行路線，而除了露營車外，將呈現各國不同的旅遊方式，含行程中的特色飯店餐廳民宿甚至市場文化等，以體驗生活融入在地為構想這一季將邀請懂料理的嘉賓為錦榮打理他的伙食，這是一個隨行廚師的概念，也是與前二季最大的不同，明星真人秀主題旅行體驗在地生活等元素的旅遊節目
融融歷險記:31 我是Ben！Youtube頻道融融歷險記 Bens Adventure的創辦人 立志前往那些沒有人要去的地方 走過五大洲75餘國，喜歡拍影片更愛與當地人交流，因為這才是旅行真正的意義 旅行的意義是什麼？ 旅行的意義，看不同的風景，認識不同的人，領略不同的美好，讓你覺得世界那麼大 人生有很多可能，讓你不再局限於一方天地，讓你看得更豁達更寬容 我想，是時候出發了

何以笙簫默 大學時代的趙默笙，對法學系大才子何以琛一見傾心，開朗直率的她死纏爛打地倒追，與眾不同的方式吸引了以琛的目光，一段純純的校園愛情悄悄滋生 然而，以琛寄養家庭的妹妹以玫，鼓起勇氣向默笙宣戰當默笙去找以琛證實，沒想到竟然得到以琛冷酷的回應誤以為以琛和以玫在一起的默笙，落寞地服從父親的安排，前往美國深造七年後，成為攝影師的默笙回來了，再次遇到那個無法忘卻的男人

何以笙簫默 大學時代的趙默笙，對法學系大才子何以琛一見傾心，開朗直率的她死纏爛打地倒追，與眾不同的方式吸引了以琛的目光，一段純純的校園愛情悄悄滋生 然而，以琛寄養家庭的妹妹以玫，鼓起勇氣向默笙宣戰當默笙去找以琛證實，沒想到竟然得到以琛冷酷的回應誤以為以琛和以玫在一起的默笙，落寞地服從父親的安排，前往美國深造七年後，成為攝影師的默笙回來了，再次遇到那個無法忘卻的男人

錦繡芳華 接續國色芳華劇情，何惟芳（楊紫 飾）出身花卉世家，聰慧果敢，擅長牡丹育植與經營之道，卻因家族牽連與朝中動盪，意外捲入一場貪腐與走私風波面對接踵而來的查緝與壓力，她選擇與冷峻神秘的花鳥使蔣長揚（ 李現 飾）達成一紙權宜婚約，企圖自保亦為翻身蔣長揚奉命徹查民間非法商貿，外冷內剛，行事果斷，原將何惟芳視為調查對象，卻在多次交鋒中發現她的聰慧與正直兩人從互相提防，到逐漸信任，進而攜手揭開朝堂與地方官商勾結的黑幕此時，驕橫跋扈的寧王暗中勢力壯大，步步進逼，而曾與惟芳有舊的劉暢李幼貞也陸續現身，將這段原本冷靜克制的合作關係推向風口浪尖面對情感與大局的拉扯，何惟芳與蔣長揚能否撐住彼此共闖亂世？

WTO姐妹會 WTO姐妹會由一群來自世界各國的新住民，在節目中分享各國生活與文化的差異，透過新住民的觀點及生活經驗，來勾勒出他們眼中的台灣及世界，並經由不同議題的討論，讓觀眾可以用開闊的視野來理解並接受異國文化
我們的翻譯官 我們的翻譯官內容主要講述一名可以即時口譯的資深翻譯官林西，在面對任何情況都可以精準地將英文翻譯成中文，讓外國人可以第一時間透過翻譯的內容了解對話，這名翻譯官因強大的工作能力，在翻譯界被有魔女的稱號但其實她是為了完成母親未完成的職業夢想，也因此犧牲了愛情與男友肖一成分手
百分百娛樂 由演藝圈同時贏得老中青三代觀眾喜愛的主持人沈玉琳擔綱主持，將時下台灣最大網路論壇影像化！透過沈玉琳一貫浮誇無厘頭的主持風格，結合最夯網路關鍵字，解讀鄉民梗圖與網路迷因，更將脆友們的日常碎念與超神回覆無限放大！在這裡，沒有最荒謬，只有更荒謬！
妹妹 周繼薇本來應該叫做周繼偉，是老媽一雪前恥的希望！ 但，當她呱呱落地之後，希望幻滅了，她那被賦予獨一無二的貴子命運，卻瞬間變成了周家第三個女兒所以她只能穿前頭兩個姊姊的舊衣服暗暗嚮往著永遠分不到的魚眼睛因為一隻魚只有兩隻眼睛一隻雞也只有兩隻腿，因此第三個的意思，就是多出來的那個但，多出來的周繼薇，卻深獲鄰居戴奶奶的喜愛，於是，她總是離家出走直奔戴家的懷抱在好乾淨好舒服的戴家，她是一個被愛包圍的小公主，還有一個帥氣的小哥哥戴耀起雖然，戴耀起根本不想有一個妹妹來跟他分食人間美味魚眼睛 想盡辦法要變成戴耀起的妹妹的周繼薇，終於在17歲那年，發現了一個連自己都不知道的秘密她不需要永恆也不需要美麗的愛情樣子，她只想要永遠跟戴耀起一起

百分百娛樂 由演藝圈同時贏得老中青三代觀眾喜愛的主持人沈玉琳擔綱主持，將時下台灣最大網路論壇影像化！透過沈玉琳一貫浮誇無厘頭的主持風格，結合最夯網路關鍵字，解讀鄉民梗圖與網路迷因，更將脆友們的日常碎念與超神回覆無限放大！在這裡，沒有最荒謬，只有更荒謬！

中國野生秘境:3 中國野生秘境:世界屋脊.中國的青藏高原是地球上最大也是最高的高原，有世界屋脊之稱，亞洲三大河流：黃河長江及湄公河都發源於此，三江源之地的水孕育了許多生命

鱷魚拍檔這一家第3季:6 鱷魚拍檔這一家第3季:針鼴寶寶.針鼴是澳洲獨特的單孔目動物，牠們是卵生哺乳類，母針鼴會在育兒袋中產下一顆蛋，然後孵化小針鼴野外針鼴的生存面臨考驗，因此澳洲動物園長期投入針鼴繁殖計畫，但繁殖針鼴非常困難，因為牠們對於配種對象很挑剔，澳洲動物園歷經20多年的努力，終於成功繁殖出一隻小針鼴但是小針鼴常有許多健康問題，因為牠們的免疫系統仍在發育中，所以園方必須讓牠體重持續增加同時，園內野生動物醫院收到另一隻被人從水坑中救起的小針鼴，但牠已經半死不活，生命岌岌可危

熱血獸醫師第4季:5 熱血獸醫師第4季:大小豬隻.在科羅拉多州一般人可以合法地把豬當寵物飼養，近年來由於所謂的新品種迷你豬，茶杯豬或袖珍豬紛紛誕生，養寵物豬也逐漸蔚為風潮，很多人把小豬買回家，以為每天餵食飼料但是豬卻不會長大，殊不知小豬竟日漸肥胖，轉眼之間就完全失控變成幾十公斤甚至上百斤的大肥豬，於是又有越來越多人棄養豬隻，在整個丹佛都會區，流浪豬無人聞問更無收容所可去，直到艾琳成立豬隻避風港這個非營利救援組織，豬隻才脫離受虐和被棄養的命運，終於有了一個安身之處，這個救援組織的終極目標是要為豬隻找到最好的歸宿，他們的策略之一就是要先為所有的豬隻絕育，因為這樣豬隻到了發情期才不會逞兇鬥狠，也比較容易成為大家能接受的寵物，但是由於組織的資金完全來自於捐款，他們的費用多半都用在豬隻的飼料和醫療上，沒有多餘的經費來做豬隻傳染病的預防，寵物計畫診所的貝爾醫師獲悉這個情況，就主動前往豬隻收容所義務出診，果真是名不虛傳的熱血
炙熱非洲:1 炙熱非洲:獅子：最乾燥的莽原.莽原上的獅子想在夜晚狩獵，但牠們平常鎖定的獵物都在白日活動，所以牠們只能頂著高溫，和獵物搏鬥
百變爬蟲箱:4 百變爬蟲箱:黑幫主題.金柏莉和傑瑞米最先是養貓，並且用黑幫人物幸運盧西安諾來取名，所以他們後來開始養蛇，就繼續從黑幫人物裡挑名字，來搭配不同蛇種的個性他們希望葛雷格幫他們打造黑幫主題的陸生缸，並且結合禁酒時期主題葛雷格的團隊想到用酒桶堆疊，每個酒桶打造成不同黑幫人物的背景，然後堆疊起來，成為一個大型爬蟲箱，成為傑瑞米和金柏莉客廳裡搶眼的擺飾

鱷魚拍檔這一家第3季:8 鱷魚拍檔這一家第3季:賓蒂的驚喜.史帝夫厄文野生動物保護區是在2007年為紀念史帝夫而設立這塊土地專門保護35個以上的生態系每一年，厄文這一家都會率團隊到這裡來設陷阱捕捉鱷魚，打上聲學標籤或衛星追蹤器來進行長期鱷魚研究這趟研究之旅的隊長是史帝夫的兒子羅伯特羅伯特展現了乃父之風，擔起全隊人員和鱷魚的安全在保護區裡，賓蒂宣布了一個大喜訊：她懷孕了厄文家族未來的野生動物戰士寶寶即將誕生！
熱血獸醫師第4季:5 熱血獸醫師第4季:大小豬隻.在科羅拉多州一般人可以合法地把豬當寵物飼養，近年來由於所謂的新品種迷你豬，茶杯豬或袖珍豬紛紛誕生，養寵物豬也逐漸蔚為風潮，很多人把小豬買回家，以為每天餵食飼料但是豬卻不會長大，殊不知小豬竟日漸肥胖，轉眼之間就完全失控變成幾十公斤甚至上百斤的大肥豬，於是又有越來越多人棄養豬隻，在整個丹佛都會區，流浪豬無人聞問更無收容所可去，直到艾琳成立豬隻避風港這個非營利救援組織，豬隻才脫離受虐和被棄養的命運，終於有了一個安身之處，這個救援組織的終極目標是要為豬隻找到最好的歸宿，他們的策略之一就是要先為所有的豬隻絕育，因為這樣豬隻到了發情期才不會逞兇鬥狠，也比較容易成為大家能接受的寵物，但是由於組織的資金完全來自於捐款，他們的費用多半都用在豬隻的飼料和醫療上，沒有多餘的經費來做豬隻傳染病的預防，寵物計畫診所的貝爾醫師獲悉這個情況，就主動前往豬隻收容所義務出診，果真是名不虛傳的熱血
可愛動物大集合:2 可愛動物大集合:最愛狗寶寶.這個世界充滿可愛的動物，但其中最可愛的可能就是大家家裡常見的小狗小狗有無窮的精力，對生活有無止盡的渴望，加上那可愛的呆萌模樣，值得登上可愛動物第一名的寶座

野生動物求生錄:3 野生動物求生錄:交配.繁殖是最接近永生不朽的事，透過求偶和交配，動物才得以延續自身物種
百變爬蟲箱:4 百變爬蟲箱:黑幫主題.金柏莉和傑瑞米最先是養貓，並且用黑幫人物幸運盧西安諾來取名，所以他們後來開始養蛇，就繼續從黑幫人物裡挑名字，來搭配不同蛇種的個性他們希望葛雷格幫他們打造黑幫主題的陸生缸，並且結合禁酒時期主題葛雷格的團隊想到用酒桶堆疊，每個酒桶打造成不同黑幫人物的背景，然後堆疊起來，成為一個大型爬蟲箱，成為傑瑞米和金柏莉客廳裡搶眼的擺飾

動物家族保衛戰 動物家族保衛戰.在動物界，繁殖與守護後代的本能凌駕於一切每一種動物都發展出獨特的策略來完成使命，展現出創意且令人驚嘆的解方
動物求生高手:4 動物求生高手:飛向高空.無論是致命一擊毒性碰觸，還是驚人速度或超凡耐力，動物天生為生存而進化演化塑造了動物的身體和行為，成為精密運作的生存機器，藏著無數不可思議的適應能力由丹歐尼爾Dan O'Neill主持，每集節目聚焦一種類別的關鍵適應能力，從可量化的極限表現，到最奇特最驚人的生存策略，全面解析動物世界的多樣面貌節目不只關注最快最強，而是更深入探索自然界中複雜的關係與特殊的行為每一類別中，將揭曉排名前20的代表物種，帶領觀眾認識動物求生高手
神秘動物大追蹤:6 神秘動物大追蹤:巴西巨森蚺.本集節目中，野生生物學家佛瑞斯特葛蘭特要去巴西波尼托尋找巨蛇根據傳說，神秘的治療師將巨蛇困在地下，拯救了這個小鎮葛蘭特要去搜索波尼托附近的地下洞窟跟叢林裡的水域，試著找到故事中的巨蛇，他能順利達成任務嗎？

探險活寶 一個呆呆的小男孩阿寶，一條充滿智慧的老狗老皮，他們成了拍檔，一同探索哇賽祕境獨特又有趣的奇幻世界他們彼此相互幫助，度過危險與困境，一起享受歡樂的時光與感動的時刻這種小孩與狗之間無價的友誼及特別的經驗，使得這部卡通更加賞心悅目
豆豆先生 豆豆先生帶著相機想要捕捉大自然的美態，可是反被大自然捕捉的他感到非常糗也非常生氣!原來是受到野生動物紀錄片的啟發，豆豆先生拿起他塵封已久的老相機出發到郊外想要捕捉完美的野生動物照片,不過瞎忙了兩天卻一點收獲也沒有,最後還發現自己竟然才是被捕捉的對象！

看美善學美善美善劇場 1945年，村岡花子邊看原文小說，邊翻查著字典，將譯文撰寫於稿紙上這一年她已經52歲，正在進行小說Anne of Green Gables的翻譯工作此時正值二次大戰末期，節節敗退的日本正遭受盟軍轟炸機的密集轟炸，因此花子在工作時，還得隨時注意外頭的狀況，若發布空襲警報，就得帶著女兒到防空洞避難每當避難時，她手上必定帶著書本及譯稿，對花子來說，這是比她的生命還重要的東西這天她一如往常的進行翻譯工作，她突然停下了筆，開始回想她這一生的經歷，花子與安妮的故事就此展開

不可能的任務 伊森韓特與小組在布拉格執行任務時，不慎中了埋伏，同組人員全遭殺害，只剩他一人倖存，當他與上級聯繫時得知，這次行動是騙局，目的是為了抓拿潛伏已久的內賊，而伊森的倖存，與帳戶突然增加的存款，讓他成了最大的嫌疑犯這時，吉姆之妻蔻拉突然死裡逃生，與伊森相聚為了洗刷冤屈，伊森決定自組人馬，與代號麥斯的買家相約見面，試圖查出真相
重返侏羅紀 面對遠古生物無情攻擊，他們設法死裡逃生為了研發抗癌藥物，正仁醫藥集團四處招兵買馬，試圖尋找傳說中的遠古植物-火獄蔓蓮當探險隊在孤島尋找時，他們突然遭到迅猛龍包圍攻擊，全數罹難身亡消息一傳回集團，為了替哥哥復仇，江海決定帶領探險隊再次前往而這時，為了早日治癒身上癌症，集團董事長陳正仁也決定隨行前往，行前他先至醫院，設法說服女兒接受化療的考古學家薛文中，表示此舉不僅可以讓他親眼目睹活化石，平反當年誤判，更可因此拯救飽受病痛折磨的女兒
驚爆封鎖線 恐攻無預警降臨，每一秒都是生死決戰前陸軍突擊兵艾瑞克與妹妹開車過橋時，遭遇恐怖份子炸橋封鎖受困於崩塌橋樑的艾瑞克，在孤立無援的極限環境下，為了帶領妹妹逃出去，為了保護無辜民眾，他必須重啟戰鬥本能，獨自對抗訓練有素的武裝分子，展開一場誓死守護的反擊
父仇風暴 面對惡勢力，他從不畏懼，絕不退縮！與女兒小安相依為命的貨櫃車司機阿洪，因工作繁忙無法照料女兒，於是將她送往寄宿學校，並答應每十天會去學校見她某日，想念父親的小安偷偷離開學校，來到父親上班的貨櫃場找他，卻被人擄走，就此音訊全無為了拯救愛女，他循線追蹤，獨自展開行動，發現女兒被非法組織帶走，他出生入死，誓死找回女兒
終極戰士-獸獵者 隱形戰士從天而降，致命浩劫接二連三，想要活命，你必須繃緊神經！娜魯為了證明自己，至野外訓練自己的狩獵能力，某日，她發現有未知生物在部落附近，卻不被哥哥與族人所認同為了證明，她偷偷前往叢林尋找，卻目睹牠現形殘殺，害怕逃跑的她，不慎掉入盜獵者陷阱誰知，盜獵者也想捕捉牠，竟然以她與哥哥為餌，誘捕這名來自外星的獵人...

富貴門 沙富來(羅嘉良)父母早亡，貧困交加中把弟弟沙寶來(馬國明)帶大；為生存在馬來西亞當老千機緣巧合下，他盜用了卓祟禧私生子卓一鳴的身份，與視他為親弟弟的大哥卓一元(呂良偉)回到香港進入卓家，搖身一變成為豪門二少爺然而在他未冒認身分之前，曾邂逅卓家千金卓一心(袁詠儀)，並兩人互生情愫，這短暫的浪漫，讓卓一心痛苦不堪，即欲斬斷這假不倫戀卓家上下從未懷?沙富來身分，極力想補償這個受苦多年的兒子，讓沙富來得到他本來失落的家庭溫暖，也讓他享受著金錢和權力的巨大誘惑，漸漸陷入貪婪恐懼嫉妒的人性試煉...

富貴門 沙富來(羅嘉良)父母早亡，貧困交加中把弟弟沙寶來(馬國明)帶大；為生存在馬來西亞當老千機緣巧合下，他盜用了卓祟禧私生子卓一鳴的身份，與視他為親弟弟的大哥卓一元(呂良偉)回到香港進入卓家，搖身一變成為豪門二少爺然而在他未冒認身分之前，曾邂逅卓家千金卓一心(袁詠儀)，並兩人互生情愫，這短暫的浪漫，讓卓一心痛苦不堪，即欲斬斷這假不倫戀卓家上下從未懷?沙富來身分，極力想補償這個受苦多年的兒子，讓沙富來得到他本來失落的家庭溫暖，也讓他享受著金錢和權力的巨大誘惑，漸漸陷入貪婪恐懼嫉妒的人性試煉...

金裝四大才子 唐伯虎(張家輝)祝枝山(歐陽震華)文徵明(林家棟)同為?州三寶，受學於六藝書院，聞名江南樹大招風，寧王義子朱子健(郭政鴻)招攬來自波斯的奇才周文賓(魏俊傑)，不擇手段擊倒三人唐伯虎三人揭穿劣行，不記前嫌，施以援手，與周文賓四人結為八拜之交寧王(高雄)賞識四人才情，引為幕僚，安排四人挖掘瓦片寶藏，而藏寶處極有可能為華太師府，派唐伯虎到太師府充當書僮，易名華安，四大才子分別與秋香(關詠荷)石榴(翁虹)朱娉婷(陳松伶)祝曉蓮(文頌嫻)各有感情試煉，也捲入寧王謀反正德皇的叛亂中

富貴門 沙富來(羅嘉良)父母早亡，貧困交加中把弟弟沙寶來(馬國明)帶大；為生存在馬來西亞當老千機緣巧合下，他盜用了卓祟禧私生子卓一鳴的身份，與視他為親弟弟的大哥卓一元(呂良偉)回到香港進入卓家，搖身一變成為豪門二少爺然而在他未冒認身分之前，曾邂逅卓家千金卓一心(袁詠儀)，並兩人互生情愫，這短暫的浪漫，讓卓一心痛苦不堪，即欲斬斷這假不倫戀卓家上下從未懷?沙富來身分，極力想補償這個受苦多年的兒子，讓沙富來得到他本來失落的家庭溫暖，也讓他享受著金錢和權力的巨大誘惑，漸漸陷入貪婪恐懼嫉妒的人性試煉...

[首播] 2026肇喜登峰巡迴賽 佳運公開賽 第三四回合(普)
新我們這一家 以立花一家人所發生的各種生活瑣事為主軸他們並非模範家庭，僅是一群平凡又普通的一般人其中包含了就算是小事情也非常認真的媽媽洗完澡光著身子在客廳走動的爸爸是個普通女高中生的女兒；兒子乍看之下雖然很酷，但其實是名實實在在的中學生
我們這一家 好笑的橘子神經大條的花媽憨厚的花爸加上悶騷的柚子組成的我們這一家，每天都發生許多爆笑有趣的事情，充滿歡樂的生活化情節，貼近你我的生活，連主題曲都讓人有充滿希望的感覺，你一定要收看
櫻桃小丸子HD 小丸子是個無憂無慮膽小不講理愛模仿對於痛苦的事很快就忘記的小孩，想知道他在學校發生的趣事，在家和家人相處情況，就別忘了鎖定喔！
超級總動員第21季 超級總動員提倡及提供各學校展現才藝表演之平台，鼓勵小學中高年級同學藉由本節目之團隊競賽，賦予同學話語權，勇於表達自己的意見及想法學習公平競爭團隊合作，本節目設計各項關卡，均由體適能專家及專科教師為顧問師資群，融入STEAM 教育理念，由製作團隊持續創新各項挑戰關卡
